sa: स एष क्षत्रधर्मेण स्थानमेतदवाप्तवान्। भये महति योऽभीतो बभूव पृथिवीपतिः॥
en: Yet through his observance of Kshatriya practices he has acquired this region. This king was not terrified in a dreadful situation.

sa: अथाब्रवीद् भीमसेनं कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिः॥ नकुलः सहदेवश्च बीभत्सुश्च परंतप! चिरं गतास्तोयहेतोर्न चागच्छन्ति भारत॥ तांश्चैवानय भद्रं ते पानीयं च त्वमानय।
en: Then, Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti spoke to Bhimsena, “O tormentor of foes, O Bhimasena Nakula, Sahadeva and Vivatsu have been long out to fetch water and they have not come as yet. You are to bring them as well as water.

sa: सधनुष्काः कवचिनो वेगादुत्सृज्य राक्षसाः॥ रावणं प्रेक्ष्य राजानं प्रहस्तं पर्यवारयन्।
en: And furnished with their boys and wearing their armour, the Rākşasas, on seeing king Ravana, leaving (their vehicles), stood, surrounding Prahasta.

sa: गोब्राह्मणहितार्थाय देशस्य च हिताय च। तव चैवाप्रमेयस्य वचनं कर्तुमुद्यतः॥
en: And in the interests of Brāhmaṇas, kine, and celestials, I am ready to act as desired by you of immeasurable energy.

sa: यदि तावत् समुद्रस्य मैनाकस्य च धीमतः। रामार्थं सम्भ्रमस्तादृक्किमग्निर्न करिष्यति॥
en: If the Ocean and the intelligent Maināka could show such regard for Råma, what may not the Fire do (for him?)

sa: यथा स राजा इक्ष्वाकुः कुवलाश्वो महीपतिः। धुन्धुमारत्वमगमत् तच्छृणुष्व महीपते॥
en: O ruler of earth, hear why the royal sage Kuvalashva of the race of Ikshvaku came to be known as Dhundhumara.

sa: इन्द्रध्वज इवोद्भूतः पौर्णमास्यां महीतले। आश्वयुक्समये मासि गतसत्वो विचेतनः। वाष्पसंरुद्धकण्ठस्तु वाली चार्तस्वरः शनैः॥
en: Like to ſakra's banner in the full-moon of Asvin, Vali, with his throat choked with vapour, losing all sense and sighing hard, fell dead down to the ground.

sa: तं मुहूर्तादिवागम्य राज्ञो मन्त्री कृताञ्जलिः॥ प्रावेशयत्ततः कक्ष्यां तृतीयां राजवेश्मनः।
en: Soon after, the king's minister, coming to that place with joined hands, conducted him to the second chamber of the palace.

sa: ततः परमसंक्रुद्धः कृतवर्मा तमब्रवीत्। निर्दिशन्निव सावज्ञं तदा सव्येन पाणिना॥
en: Greatly enraged at this, Kritavarman, cmphasising his disregard for Satyaki by pointing to him with his left hand, said these words:

sa: इत्येष विधिरुद्दिष्टो मया ते द्विपदां वर। श्रद्दधानेन वै भाव्यं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
en: I have thus indicated the ordinances, O foremost of men, (about the manner of reciting these scriptures) in response to your enquiries, You should observe them with faith.

sa: विश्रुतस्त्रिषु लोकेषु वदान्यः सत्यसंगरः। स तत्र पुरुषव्याघ्रः शशास पृथिवीमिमाम्॥
en: Famed over the three worlds, and munificent, and linn in promise in battle, the tiger among men ruled over this earth.

sa: प्रयाताश्चार्यसंघाता रामं द्रष्टुं सलक्ष्मणम्। तस्यैव च कथाश्चित्राः कुर्वाणा हृष्टमानसाः॥
en: And the honourable persons (belonging to all the three orders) went with the object of beholding Rāma in company with Lakşmaņa.

sa: ततो हि वरणं कार्यं द्विजानां भरतर्षभ। सर्वकामैर्यथान्यायं साधुभिश्च पृथग्विधैः॥
en: After this, O chief of the Bharatas. Brahmanas should be duly served with various kinds of enjoyable articles and superior things.

sa: उत्पत्स्यते कुले ह्यस्मिनिक्ष्वाकूणां महात्मनाम्। रामो दाशरथि म यस्ते प्राणान्हरिष्यति।३०॥
en: There shall spring in the line of the highsouled Ikşvāku, one named Rāma son to Dasaratha who shall deprive your life.

sa: ततो राक्षसराजेन क्रुद्धेन नृपतिस्तदा। तलेनाभिहतो मूर्ध्नि स रथानिपपात ह॥
en: Then the king, smitten on the head with a slap by the enraged king of Rākşasas, dropped down from his car.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु समरे हार्दिक्य नवभिः शरैः। आजधानोरसि क्रुद्धः पीडयन् हृदिकात्मजम्॥
en: Worked up with anger, Dhristadyumna, in that battle, assailed Hridika's son violently and struck him on the chest with nine arrows.

sa: अस्माकमपि वार्ष्णेय वने विचरतां तदा। न तथा प्रणयो राज्ये यथा सम्प्रति वर्तते॥
en: O you of the Vrishni race, the love of kingdom, which now exists among us, did not exist to the same degree when we wandered in the woods.

sa: ततस्तु जलशेषेण लक्ष्मणोऽप्यकरोत् तदा। वाग्यतास्ते त्रयः संध्यां समुपासन्त संहिताः॥
en: Then Lakşmaņa drank up the water that remained. Then the three with fixed minds silently performed their adorations to the Twilight.

sa: तत्र कश्चिद्ऋषिरासाञ्चक्रे श्रुतश्रवा नाम। तपस्यभिरतः पुत्र आस्ते सोमश्रवा नाम॥
en: Where lived a Rishi, named Srutashrava; he had a son who was named Somashrava, who was deeply engaged in austere penances.

sa: समर्थोऽयं भवतः सर्वाः पापकृत्याः शमयितुमन्तरेण महादेवकृत्याम्॥
en: "He is able to absolve you from all sins except those committed against Mahadeva.

sa: ततो मामब्रवीद् रामः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः। जानी मां गुरुं भीष्म गृह्णासीमां न चैव ह॥
en: Then did Rama say to me with eyes red with anger, “You know me to be your preceptor, O Bhishma, and yet you will not accept this lady,

sa: पारणं प्रथमं प्राप्य द्विजान् कामैश्च तर्पयन्। अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं वै लभते नरः॥
en: When the first Parana is reached, the hearer should satisfy Brahmanas with presents of all desirable objects. By doing this, one acquires the fruits of the Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sa: तस्य नाम्ना समाख्यातो जम्बूद्वीप: सनातनः॥ योजनानां सहस्रं च शतं च भरतर्षभ। उत्सेधो वृक्षराजस्य दिवस्पृङ्मनुजेश्वरः॥ अरत्नीनां सहस्रं च शतानि दश पञ्च च। परिणाहस्तु वृक्षस्य फलानां रसभेदिनाम्॥ पतमानानि तान्युर्वी कुर्वन्ति विपुलं स्वनम्।
en: This country has been named Jambudvipa after the name of this tree. O best of the Bharata race, O ruler of men, this tree is in height one thousand and one hundred Yojanas. It touches the very heavens. The circumference of a fruit of that free which bursts by itself when ripe is eleven thousand and five hundred cubits. In falling on the ground, they make a very loud noise.

sa: प्रथितस्य च कर्णस्य निपेतुस्तुरगा भुवि। अस्थिवर्षं च पतितमन्तरिक्षाद् भयानकम्॥
en: After the departure of Karna his horses trembled down on earth. And a dreadful shower of bones fell from the sky.

sa: ततः सुग्रीवसचिवाः पर्वतेन्द्रे समाहिताः। संगम्य कपिमुख्येन सर्वे प्राञ्जलयः स्थिताः॥
en: Stationed on that best of mountains the ministers of Sugrīva, coming in the front of that monkey-chief, stood with clasped palms.

sa: यथाक्रमं तदा पाणिं जग्राह रघुनन्दन। ब्रह्मदत्तो महीपालस्तासां देवपतिर्यथा ॥
en: And O descendant of Raghu, king Brahmadatta resembling the lord himself of the celestials, by turns received their hands in marriage.

sa: सोमकैः सह। विरथान् रथिनश्चक्रे पिता देवव्रतस्तव। पतितान्युत्तमाङ्गानि हयेभ्यो हयसादिनाम्॥
en: Your sire Devavrata deprived car-warriors of their car; and the heads of horse-soldiers fell fast as they rode on their chargers.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनो महाराज लब्धलक्षो महा पुजः। विनिर्ययो रथेनैव श्वेताश्वः कृष्णसारथिः॥
en: Then the mighty-armed Arjuna, O king, of sure aim, having Krishna for his driver and white horses, advanced on his car.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। नारदेन पुरा प्रोक्तं शीलमाश्रित्य भारत॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Regarding it the following old narrative is cited. It was formerly recited by Narada, with regard to virtuous conduct.

sa: स हि देवोऽत्यगाद् देवांस्तपसा विक्रमेण चा तस्माच्छरणमभ्येमि गिरिशं शूलपाणिनम्॥
en: In ascetic practices and power, he far! excells all the gods. I shall, therefore, seek refuge with Girisha armed with trident.'

sa: तांश्च सर्वान् महेष्वासान् पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः शरैः॥ विव्याध तरसा राजस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्।
en: Shalya, however, quickly struck in return each of those great bowmen with five arrows, O king. Exceedingly wonderful was this feat.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तमुवाच महाराज व्यासो वेदविदां वरः। नारदं समभिप्रेक्ष्य सर्वज्ञानां पुरातनम्॥ श्रोतुमिच्छसि चेद् धर्मं निखिलेन नराधिप। प्रैहि भीष्मं महाबाहो वृद्धं कुरुपितामहम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then Vyasa, O king, that foremost of all persons conversant with the Vedas, looking at that ancient and omniscient person, viz., Narada, said,-If O king, you wish to hear of duties and morality at length, then ask Bhishma, O mighty-armed one, that old grandfather of the Kurus.

sa: ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन धर्मपुत्रस्य मारिष॥ धनुश्चिच्छेद समरे सज्यं स सुमहारथः।
en: With another broad-headed arrow, that great car-warrio; then, O sire, cut off the stringed bow, of Dharma's son in that battle.

sa: अहं त्वानुप्रवेक्ष्यामि नकुलान्मे महद् भयम्। त्रायस्व भो मा वधीस्त्वं शक्तोऽस्मि तव रक्षणे॥
en: I will crouch myself beneath your body. I am in great fear of the mongoose. Do you save me. Kill me not. I am capable to save you.

sa: एतत्ते वृद्धकन्याया व्याख्यातं चरितं महत्॥ तथैव ब्रह्मचर्यं च स्वर्गस्य च गतिः शुभा।
en: This is the illustrious history of the old maid that I have narrated. This is the account of her Brahmacharya and her sacred departure for the celestial regions.

sa: रत्नानि च विचित्राणि महार्हाणि महायशाः। युधिष्ठिरस्तु द्रोणस्य कर्णस्य च महात्मनः॥ धृष्टद्युम्नाभिमन्युभ्यां हैडिम्बस्य च रक्षसः। विराटप्रभृतीनां च सुहृदामुपकारिणाम्॥ द्रुपदद्रौपदेयानां द्रौपद्या सहितो ददौ।
en: Yudhishthira, accompanied by Draupadi, distributed much wealth for the sake of Drona and the great Karna, of Dhrishtadyumna and Abhimanyu, of the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha the son of Hidimba, and of Virata, and his other well-wishers who had served him loyally, and of Drupada and the five sons of Draupadi.

sa: तत्रोपविष्टो धर्मात्मा श्वेताः सुमनसोऽस्पृशत्। स्वस्तिकानक्षतान् भूमि सुवर्ण रजतं मणिम्॥
en: Seated there, the righteous king, touched the beautiful white flowers, Swastikas, vessels full of various articles, earth, gold, silver, and gems.

sa: धर्मारामान् धर्मपरान् ये न रक्षन्ति मानवाान्। पार्थिवाः पुरुषव्याघ्र तेषां पापं हरन्ति ते॥
en: On the other hand, if kings, O foremost of men, do not protect the righteous people within their territories they then visited by the sins of the latter.

sa: स ततो ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा प्रहादं पाकशासनः। गत्वा प्रोवाच मेधावी श्रेय इच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: The chastiser of Paka, endued with supreme intelligence, assumed the form of a Brahman and going to Prahlada, asked him saying-I desire to hear what conduces to felicity.

sa: तमुद्यतगदं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवानां महारथम्॥ वित्रेसुस्तावका: सैन्याः शकृन्मूत्रे च सुस्रवुः।
en: Seeing that great car-warrior of the Pandavas with uplifted mace, your soldiers were possessed by fear and passed urine and excreta.

sa: सहदेवस्तु समरे मातुलं भूरिवर्चसम्। सज्यमन्यद् धनुः कृत्वाः पञ्चभिः समताडयत्॥
en: Sahadeva then, stringing another bow, pierced his maternal uncle with five arrows that resembled snakes of virulent poison or burning fire.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु पलितस्तमर्थमुभयोर्हितम्। हेतुमद् ग्रहणीयं च कालापेक्षी न्यवेक्ष्य च॥
en: Having said so, which was beneficial to both of them, highly reasonable and acceptable, the mouse Palita waited for an answer.

sa: दुर्योधनमभित्यज्य त्रय एते व्यवस्थिताः। कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च द्रौणिश्चैव महारथः॥
en: Those there, viz., Kripa and Kritavarman and the great car-warrior Ashvatthaman, have left Duryodhana's side and taken up their positions elsewhere.

sa: ते भिन्नदेहा व्यसरो निपेतुः कर्णेषुभिर्भूमितले स्वनन्तः। क्रुद्धेन सिंहेन यथेभयूथा महावने भीमबलेन तद्वत्॥
en: Like powerful elephants when killed by a mighty and angry lion, they fell down dead on the earth with loud noise being struck by those shafts of Karna.

sa: विसृष्टं हि मया दिव्यमेतदस्त्रं दुरासदम्। अपाण्डवायेति मुने वह्नितेजोऽनुमन्त्र्य वै॥
en: Having put into this irresistible and celestial weapon the energy of fire, I discharged it for the destruction of the Pandavas.

sa: ज्वलन्तीं प्राहिणोत् तस्मै भूतं तामपि चाग्रसत्। ततः सर्वायुधाभावे वीक्षमाणस्ततस्ततः॥
en: At last, when all his weapons were exhausted, Ashvatthaman, looking around, saw the entire sky densely crowded with images of Janarddana.

sa: न व्याहरति चैवेनं जैगीषव्यः कथंचन॥ काष्ठभूतोऽऽश्रमपदे वसति स्म महातपाः।
en: The great ascetic Jaigishavya never spoke a word to Devala but lived in the latter's hermitage like a log of wood.

sa: अकाले विप्रमुक्तान्मे त्वत्त एव भयं भवेत्। तस्मात् कालं प्रतीक्षस्व किमिति त्वरसे सखे॥
en: If you are freed at an improper time, I shall have to fear you. Therefore, do you wait for the proper moment. Do not be impatient, О friend.

sa: शस्याभिहारं कुर्याच्च स्वयमेव नराधिपः। असम्भवे प्रवेशस्य दहेद् दावाग्निना भृशम्॥
en: He should deposit all sorts of grain in his forts. If that is impossible, he should destroy them completely by fire.

sa: किं कार्यं सर्वधर्माणां गरीयो भवतो मतम्। यथाहं परमं धर्ममिह च प्रेत्य चाप्नुयाम्॥
en: What are the most important duties in your view by the practice of which I may acquire the highest merit both in this world and in the next.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच द्वारदेशे ततो द्रौणिमवस्थितमवेक्ष्य तौ। अकुर्वातां भोजकृपौ किं संजय वदस्व मे॥
en: Dhritarashtra Said “Seeing Drona's son stop at the gate of the camp, what, O Sanjaya, did those two great car-warriors, viz., Kripa and Kritavarman, do? Tell me this."

sa: भूतग्रामे विवृद्धे तु तुष्टे लोकगुरावपि। उदतिष्ठज्जलाज्ज्येष्ठः प्रजाश्चेमा ददर्श सः॥
en: After the creatures had multiplied and Brahma had become well gratified, the firstborn rose from water and saw the living creation.

sa: न बभौ भास्करचापि सोमः श्रीमुक्तमण्डलः। तिमिरेणाकुलं सर्वमाकाशं चाभवद् वृतम्॥
en: The Sun's effulgence decreased. The disc of the Moon lost its beauty. The entire sky was covered with a thick darkness.

sa: तथा शान्तनवो भीष्मो न्यस्तशस्त्रो निरायुधः। शिखण्डिनं पुरस्कृत्य हतो गाण्डीवधन्वना॥
en: Similarly Shantanu's son Bhishma, after he had laid aside his weapons was killed by Arjuna with Shikhandin placed in his rear.

sa: राजा च पार्षतं विद्ध्वा शरैः पञ्चभिराशुगैः। द्रोणहन्तारमुरेषु पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः॥
en: Having struck with five arrows the slayer of Drona, viz., Prishata's son the Kuru king again struck him with seven arrows.

sa: दिवं ते शिरसा व्याप्तं पद्भ्यां देवी वसुन्धरा। विक्रमेण त्रयो लोकाः पुरुषोऽसि सनातनः॥
en: You have filled heaven with your head, and Earth with your, and feet the three worlds with your energy. You are Eternal. and permeate everything in the universe.

sa: ततस्तु नकुलः शूरो धर्मराजे प्रपीडते। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन मातुलं मातृनन्दनः॥
en: Seeing the just king Yudhishthira greatly assailed the heroic Nakula, the son of Madri, rushed with force against his maternal uncle.

sa: त्वं हि मे जातितः शत्रुः सामर्थ्यान्मित्रतां गतः॥ तत् कृत्यमभिनिवर्त्य प्रकृतिः शत्रुतां गता।
en: You are by nature my enemy. From circumsiances you became my friend. That state of things has gone away. The old but natural state of enmity has returned.

sa: यस्तेषां तदवस्थानां दुह्येत पुरुषोऽनृजुः। व्यक्तं स नरके मज्जेदगाधे विपुलेऽप्लवे॥
en: That wicked man who would injure them then, would sink in deep and limitless hell without a raft to save himself.

sa: यदि त्वं सुकृतं वेत्सि तत् सख्यमनुसारय॥ प्रशान्तादपि मे पापाद् भेतव्यं बलिन: सदा।
en: To live near a powerful and strong person is never praiseworthy. Even if the estimated danger no longer exists, I should always fear one more powerful than myself.

sa: अथ देवाः समागम्य विष्णुमूचुः प्रजापतिम्। एको योऽर्हति मत्र्येभ्यः श्रेष्ठ्यं वै तं समादिश॥
en: Then, approaching that lord of creatures, viz., Vishnu, the god said to him,-Point out, O god, that one among men who deserves to reign supreme over the rest.

sa: विक्षोभयन्तं सेनां ते त्रासयन्तं च पार्थिवान्। धनंजयमपश्याम नलिनीमिव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: While agitating your army and terrorizing the kings we have seen Dhananjaya resemble an elephant agitating a lake full of lotuses.

sa: ते वध्यामानाः समरे पाण्डवा नावतस्थिरे। निवार्यमाणा भीमेन पश्यतोः कृष्णयोस्तदा॥ ततो धनंजयः क्रुद्धः कृपं सह पदानुगैः। अवाकिरच्छरौघेण कृतवर्माणमेव च॥
en: Struck by the Kurus, the Pandava troops, in the very presence of the two Krishnas, could not stand in the field though checked by Bhimasena. Worked up with anger Dhananjaya covered Kripa and his followers, as also Kritavarman, with showers of arrows.

sa: मातापितृसहस्राणि पुत्रदारशतानि च। संसारेष्वनुभूतानि कस्य ते कस्य वा वयम्॥
en: There are thousands of mothers and fathers and sons and wives in this world. Whose are they and whose are we?

sa: सर्वेषां भूतसंघानां हर्षान्नादः समुत्थितः। अपूरयत लोकांस्त्रीन् वरे दत्ते महात्मना॥
en: After Skanda had granted that boon a tremendous sound uprose from all those creatures full of joy, filling the three worlds.

sa: द्रौपदेया नरेन्द्रांश्च भूयिष्ठान् समवारयन्। द्रोणपुत्रं च पाञ्चाल्य: शिखण्डी समवारयत्॥
en: The (five) sons of Draupadi opposed numerous kings (of the Kuru army). The Panchala prince Shikhandin checked the son of Drona.

sa: तमेवंवादिनं भूयः पर्वतः प्रत्यभाषत। वृणीष्व राजन् संकल्पं यत् ते हृदि चिरं स्थितम्॥
en: To Srinjaya who said so, Parvata again said, —Pray, o king, for the fruition of that wish which you are cherishing in your heart for a long time.

sa: स हन्यमाने सैन्ये स्वे मुचुकुन्दो नराधिपः। गर्हयामास विद्वांसं पुरोहितमरिंदमः॥
en: Witnessing the destruction of his army, king Muchukunda, O chastiser of foes, began to remonstrate with his own feared priest Vasishtha.

sa: यशस्विनीनां मातृणां शृणु नामानि भारत। याभिाप्तास्त्रयो लोकाः कल्याणीभिश्च भागशः॥
en: Listen, O, Bharata, to the names of those illustrious mothers. The mobile and immobile universe is permeated by those auspicious ones.

sa: अवतीर्य रथेभ्यश्च प्राद्रवन् राजसंनिधौ। दुर्योधनं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य सर्वे भीमावुपाविशन्॥
en: Getting down from their cars, they ran towards the king. Seeing Duryodhana, all of them sat on the Earth around him.

sa: नारद उवाच एवमेतन्महाबाहो यथायं केशवोऽब्रवीत्। कार्यस्यास्य तु यच्छेषं तत् ते वक्ष्यामि पृच्छतः॥
en: Narada said 'It is so, O you of mighty arms, as Keshava here has said, asked by you I shall now recite the remaining portion of this story.

sa: महाहवे तं बहु रोचमानं धनंजयं भूतगणा: समेताः। तदान्वमोदन्त जनार्दनं च दिवाकरावभ्युदितौ यथैव॥
en: Then all the creatures in a body congratulated Dhananjaya who was shining in the battle-field and Janardana, those two foremost of men who were like two risen suns.

sa: शैनेयो दक्षिणं चक्रं धृष्टद्युम्नस्तथोत्तरम्॥ पृष्ठगोपो भवत्वद्य मम पार्थो धनंजयः।
en: The grandson of Shini will protect my right wheel and Dhristadyumna my left. Let Pritha's son Dhananjaya guard my rear to-day.

sa: यमं चातियमं चैव तिमिवक्त्रौ महाबलौ॥ प्रददौ कार्तिकेयाय वरुणः सत्यसङ्गरः।
en: The truthful Varuna gave him Ghasa and Atighasa of great might and having a mouth like that of the Timi fish.

sa: तथैव कुरुराजोऽपि प्रगृह्य रुचिरं धनुः॥ द्रोणोपदेशान् विविधान् दर्शयानो महामनाः।
en: Also, having taken up his beautiful bow, the great king of the Kurus displayed various lessons received by him from Drona.

sa: तस्यास्तेनोपचारेण रूपेणाप्रतिमेन च।॥ नारदं हृच्छयस्तूर्णं सहसैवाभ्यपद्यत।
en: Her dutiful services and her peerless beauty very soon created love in Narada's heart.

sa: शशिप्रकाशाननमर्जुनो यदा क्षुरेण कर्णस्य शिरो न्यपातयत्। तदान्तरिक्षे सहसैव शब्दो बभूव हाहेति सुरैर्विमुक्तः॥
en: When with his razor-shaped arrows Arjuna cut-off Karna's head having a moon-like countenance all the denizens of heaven, sky and earth sent forth cries of Oh and Alas!

sa: अथ सत्यवती गर्भ क्षत्रियान्तकरं तदा। धारयामास दीप्तेन वपुषा घोरदर्शनम्॥
en: Thereupon Satyavati, her body blazing with lustre, conceived a child of dreadful form intended to become the exterminator of the Kshatriyas.

sa: ब्रह्मदत्त उवाच यः कृते प्रतिकुर्याद् वै न स तत्रापरानुयात्। अनृणस्तेन भवति वस पूजनि मा गमः॥
en: Brahmadatta said One, who does return injury for an injury, is never considered as offending. Indeed, the avenger closes his account by such behaviour. Therefore, O Pujani, continue to live here without quitting this place!

sa: साध्या विश्वेऽथ मरुतो वसवः पितरस्तथा॥ रुद्रादित्यास्तथा सिद्धा भुजगाः दानवाः खगाः। ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूभगवान् सपुत्रः सह विष्णुना॥ शक्रस्तथाभ्ययाद् द्रष्टुं कुमारवरमच्युतम्।
en: The Saddhyas, the Vishvedevas, the Maruts, the Vasus, the Pitris, the Rudras, the Adityas, the Siddhas, the Danavas, the birds, the self-create and worshipful Brahman with his sons and Vishnu and Shakra, all went there for beholding that child of ever-increasing glory.

sa: धनुर्वेदश्चतुष्पादः शस्त्रग्रामः ससंग्रहः। तत्रैनं समुपातिष्ठत् साक्षाद् वाणी च केवला॥
en: The science of arms, with its four divisions and all the weapons, as also all kinds of arrows, came to him.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनं दृष्ट्वा वाजिमध्ये व्यवस्थितम्। उवाच देवकीपुत्रः कुन्तीपुत्रं धनंजयम्॥ शत्रवो हतभूयिष्ठा ज्ञातयः परिपालिताः। गृहीत्वा संजयं चासौ निवृत्तः शिनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: Seeing Duryodhana in the midst of the cavalry, Krishna said to Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti:-"A large number of our enemies, relations that had received our protection, have been killed. There that best of Shini's race is returning, having taken Sanjaya captive.

sa: तस्य तचरितं दृष्ट्वा संग्रामे भीमकर्मणः। वित्रेसुस्तावकाः सर्वे शल्यस्त्वेनं समभ्ययात्॥
en: Beholding the feats of that hero of terrible deeds, all your warriors were filled with fear. Shalya, however, rushed again him.

sa: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय शल्यं शरशतैस्त्रिभिः॥ अविध्यत् कार्मुकं चास्य क्षुरेण निरकृन्तत।
en: Taking up another bow, Yudhishthira struck Shalya with three hundred arrows and cut off the latter's bow with a razor-faced arrow.

sa: मनो मे रमतां सत्ये त्वत्प्रसादाद्भुताशन। लेभे च कामांस्तान् सर्वान् पावकादिति नः श्रुतम्॥११३
en: Let my heart ever love Truth, through your 'grace, O eater of sacrificial libations.-It has been heard by us that king Gaya secured all those wishes from Agni.

sa: यशसः पतितो दीप्ताद् घातयित्वा सहोदरान्॥ इमौ हि वृद्धौ शोकाग्नौ प्रक्षिप्य स सुयोधनः। अस्मत्प्रद्वेषसंयुक्तः पापबुद्धिः सदैव ह॥ को हि बन्धुः कुलीनः संस्तथा ब्रूयात् सुहृज्जने। यथासाववदद् वाक्यं युयुत्सुः कृष्णसंनिधौ॥
en: Forsooth, Suyodhana, having caused his uterine brothers to be king and having cast this old pair into burning grief, has fallen off from shining glory. Burning with the hate he bore to us, Duryodhana was always sinful at heart. What other highly-born kinsman could use such language towards kinsman as he, with a view of fight, actually used in the presence of Krishna?

sa: कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य ऋषयः सुतपोधनाः। तीर्थयात्रां समाजग्मुः सरस्वत्यां महीपते॥
en: After some time had passed away, some Rishis, having asceticism for their wealth, came to the Sarasvati, O king, on pilgrimage.

sa: स तस्य पुरुषेन्द्रस्य प्रभावेण महौजसः। ददाह कार्तवीर्यस्य शैलानथ वनस्पतीन्॥
en: Through the prowess of that foremost of inen, viz., the powerful Kartavirya, the god of fire consumed mountains and great forests.

sa: यस्येह यजमानस्य यज्ञे यज्ञे पुरोहितः। सहस्रं वारणान् हैमान् दक्षिणामत्यकालयत्॥
en: In each sacrifice celebrated by him, the chief priest received as sacrificial fee a thousand elephants made of gold. seven was

sa: यांश्चापि निहतान् युद्धे राजंस्त्वमनुशोचसि। न शोच्या हि महात्मानः सर्वे ते त्रिदिवं गताः॥
en: Those again, O king, that have fallen in battle and for whom you bewail, are not really objects of your grief, since all those illustrious persons to heaven.

sa: प्रगल्भाश्चानुरक्ताश्च ते तव स्युः परिच्छदाः॥ दौष्कुलेयाश्च लुब्धाश्च नृशंसा निरपत्रपाः।
en: Persons of low birth, who are covetous, cruel and shameless, would seek you, O sire, as long as they are paid.

sa: तस्यैतत् तपसः कर्म येन तेऽद्य लयो महान्॥ अपां कुर्छ सरस्वत्यास्तं प्रसादय पार्थिव।
en: This is the fruit of ascetic rites. Thence is this great calamity! Go, O king and propitiate that Rishi who is living on the bank of the Sarasvati.'

sa: ततो वर्षसहस्रेषु समतीतेषु केषुचित्॥ क्षेपं सम्प्राप्तवांस्तत्र प्रकृत्या कोपन: प्रभुः।
en: Afterwards, after the expiry of some thousands of years, the powerful Rama, who was angry by nature, was accused of cowardice.

sa: मद्रराजं महेष्वासं परिवार्य समन्ततः। स्थिता राजन् महासेना योद्धुकामा समन्ततः॥
en: Those great warriors, encircling that great bowmen, the king of the Madras, stood, O king, desirous of fighting on every side.

sa: अद्य राजा सत्यधृतिर्हतामित्रो युधिष्ठिरः। अद्य दुर्योधनो हीनो दीप्ताया नृपतिश्रियः॥
en: To day the truthful king Yudhishthira, had defeated his enemies. Today Duryodhana has been divested of his splendour and royal prosperity.

sa: यः प्रमाणमतिक्रम्य प्रतिलोमं नराधिपः। भृत्यान् स्थापयतेऽबुद्धिर्न स रञ्जयते प्रजाः॥
en: That foolish king, who, disregarding precedent, appoints servants to offices for which they are not fit, fails to please his people.

sa: ऋषय ऊचुः अहो बतायं शकुनिर्विघसाशान् प्रशंसति। अस्मान् नूनमयं शास्ति वयं च विघसाशिनः॥
en: Hearing these words, the Rishis said,-Lo, this bird praises those who live upon the remnants of Sacrifices! He mentions this to us, for we live upon such remnants!

sa: स हतः प्रापतद् भूमौ स्वरथाद् रथिनां वरः। गिरेस्तु कूटजो भग्नो मारुतेनेव पादपः॥
en: Thus struck, that best of car-warriors fell down on the ground from his car, like a tree growing on the summit of a mountain uprooted by the storm.

sa: तदद्भुतमपश्याम तव पुत्रस्य पौरुषम्॥ यदेकं सहिताः पार्था न शेकुरतिवर्तितुम्।
en: The prowess of your son was highly wonderful, since all the Parthas, in a body, could not transgress his single self.

sa: तमेवंवादिनं भीतं संनिकर्षगतं तदा। नोवाच किंचिद् गान्धारी निःश्वासपरमा भृशम्॥
en: Gandhari, singing heavily, said nothing to Yudhishthira-who spoke such words, who was overcome with fear, and who stood in ner presence.

sa: ततो दृष्ट्वा स शार्दूलो नाहनत् तं विशाम्पते। स तु श्वा व्याघ्रतां प्राप्य बलवान् पिशिताशनः॥ न मूलफलभोगेषु स्पृहामप्यकरोत् तदा।
en: The tiger seeing a beast of his own species did not injure him, O king. Having in course of time been metamorphosed into a powerful tiger living upon flesh and blood, the dog, abstained from his former food of fruits and roots.

sa: व्यास उवाच अतिवेलं महाराज न शोकं कर्तुमर्हसि॥ पुनरुक्तं तु वक्ष्यामि दिष्टमेतदिति प्रभो।
en: Vyasa said 'You should not, O king, indulge in such painful grief. I shall again say what I have once said. All this is Destiny, O powerful one.

sa: धार्तराष्ट्रा हि राजेन्द्र योधास्तु स्वल्पमन्तरम्॥ अपश्यमाना राजानं पर्यवर्तन्त दंशिताः।
en: Meanwhile the Dhartarashtras, O king, who had not fled far away, beholding the king, rallied and returned there, clad in mail.

sa: एतदेवंविधं वीर सम्पश्यायोधनं विभो। पश्यमाना हि दह्यामि शोकेनाहं जनार्दन॥
en: Behold, O powerful hero, the field of battle in this state! At this sight, O Janarddana, I am burning with grief.

sa: आपदर्थं च निर्यातं धनं त्विह विवर्धयेत्॥ राष्ट्रं च कोशभूतं स्यात् कोशो वेश्मगतस्तथा।
en: Does not the king then acquire wealth enough to meet his wants? The entire kingdom becomes then to him his treasury, and his treasury becomes his bed room.

sa: यज्ञाय सृष्टानि धनानि धात्रा यज्ञाय सृष्टः पुरुषो रक्षिता च। तस्मात् सर्वं यज्ञ एवोपयोज्यं धनं न कामाय हितं प्रशस्तम्॥
en: Wealth was created by the Creator for celebrating Sacrifices, and man was created by hinn for protecting that wealth and performing Sacrifices. For this, all wealth should be devoted to Sacrifices. It is not proper that it should be spent for enjoyments.

sa: मामेव नूनं बीभत्सुर्मामेव च वृकोदरः। अभियामिति मन्वाना: पेतुर्मम्लुश्च सम्भ्रमात्॥
en: on The Kauravas, pale with fear, thought “Vibhatsa is following me, Vrikodaras is pursing me" and fell down as they fled.

sa: स्वागतेन च ते तत्र प्रतिपूज्य समन्ततः॥ पश्य युद्धं महाबाहो इति ते राममब्रुवन्। एवमूचुर्महात्मानं रौहिणेयं नराधिपाः॥
en: The other kings honored him by welcoming him and then all of them said to Rama "Witness this encounter, O you of mighty arms.”—Even thus those mighty car-warriors said to the high-souled son of Rohini.

sa: सुमन्त्रितं सुविक्रान्तं सुयुद्धं सुपलायितम्। आपदास्पदकाले तु कुर्वीत न विचारयेत्॥
en: When calamities befall the king, he should advise wisely, show his prowess properly, fight with ability, and even retreat with wisdom.

sa: यदेतन्मन्यसे पार्थ न ज्यायोऽस्ति धनादिति। न स्वर्गो न सुखं नार्थो निर्धनस्येति तन्मृषा॥
en: You think, O Partha, that there is nothing superior to wealth, and that the poor man can neither have heaven, nor happiness, nor the accomplishment of his wishes.

sa: पानागारनिवेशाच वेश्याः प्रापणिकास्तथा। कुशीलवाः सकितवा ये चान्ये केचिदीदृशाः॥ नियम्याः सर्व एवैते ये राष्ट्रस्योपघातकाः। एते राष्ट्रेऽभितिष्ठन्तो बाधन्ते भद्रिकाः प्रजाः॥
en: Drinking-shops, public women, pimps, actors, gamblers, and keepers of gambling houses, and other persons, of this sort, who always create disorders to the states, should all be checked. Living within the kingdom, these afflict and injure the better classes of the subjects.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा क्रोधेन महता युतः। जिगीषमाणः संग्रामे धार्तराष्ट्रान् सराजकान्॥ त्रिभिः शारद्वतं विद्ध्वा रुक्मपुङ्खः शिलाशितैः। चतुर्भिनिजघानाश्वान् नाराचैः कृतवर्मणः॥
en: Filled with great anger and desirous of defeating the Dhartarashtras and their king in that battle, king Yudhishthira struck the son of Sharadvata with three gold winged arrows whetted on stone and next killed with four others the four horses of Kritavarman.

sa: दुःखमेवास्ति न सुखं तस्मात् तदुपलभ्यते। तृष्णार्तिप्रभवं दुःखं दुःखार्तिप्रभवं सुखम्॥
en: There is only sorrow in this world and not happiness. Therefore sorrow only is felt. Desire begets sorrow and sorrow happiness.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज नकुलः परवीरहा। शरैस्तस्य दिशः सर्वाश्छादयामास वीर्यवान्॥
en: At this the impetuous Nakula, O king, that slayer of hostile heroes, covered all the points of the compass with shafts.

sa: अयं स कालः सम्प्राप्तो मित्राणां मित्रवत्सल॥ यत्र मित्रममित्रं वा परीक्षन्ते बुधा जनाः।
en: "O You attached to friends, that time has arrived when intelligent men examine persons in the guise of friends as to whether they are true friends or not.

sa: दुर्योधनवचः श्रुत्वा शल्यो मद्राधिपस्तदा। उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञो राजन् राजसंनिधौ॥
en: Hearing the words of Duryodhana, Shalya, the king of Madra, foremost of orators, said following words before the kings, O king!

sa: अस्य भार्याऽऽमिषप्रेप्सून् गृध्रकाकांस्तपस्विनी। वारयत्यनिशं बाला न च शक्नोति माधव॥
en: His helpless young wife, O Madhava, is continually but unsuccessfully trying to drive away those vultures desirous of feeding on carrion.

sa: त्वया दत्तां न चेच्छेयं पृथिवीमखिलामहम्। त्वां तु युद्धे विनिर्जित्य भोक्तास्मि वसुधामिमाम्।। ५८
en: I do not, therefore, wish to have the Earth as a gift from you. I shall, on the other hand, enjoy the Earth after defeating you in battle.

sa: एवं राजोपनिषदं ययातिः स्माह नाहुषः। मनुष्यविषये युक्तो हन्ति शत्रूननुत्तमान्॥
en: Nahusha's son Yayati, in describing the mysteries of king-craft, said that a person in ruling men should kill even contemptible foes.

sa: ऋष्टिभिर्विमलाभिश्च तत्र तत्र विशाम्पते। सम्पतन्तीभिराकाशमावृतं बह्वशोभत॥
en: The entire sky, O king, covered with falling and bright sword, appeared highly beautiful.

sa: पश्य वैकर्तनं कर्णं निहत्यातिरथान् बहून्। शोणितौघपरीताङ्गं शयानं पतितं भुवि॥
en: See, Vikartana's son Karna, after having killed many Atirathas, has been prostrated on the naked Earth and is covered with blood.

sa: प्रतियातो हि शकुनिः स्वमनीकमवस्थितः॥ न पुनः सौबलो राजा युद्धमभ्यागमिष्यति।
en: Having retreated Shakuni is now staying within his own detachment. The royal son of Subala will not again come to fight.”

sa: पाण्डवाश्च महेष्वासा व्यूह्य सैन्यमरिन्दमाः॥ विधा भूता महाराज तव सैन्यमुपाद्रवन्।
en: The great bowmen amongst the Pandavas, those chastisers of foes, dividing themselves, O king, into three divisions, rushed against your troops.

sa: अर्जुनस्य विनेतारमाचार्यं सात्यकेस्तथा। तं पश्य पतितं द्रोणं कुरूणां गुरुमुत्तमम्॥
en: See Drona, that best of Brahmanas, that preceptor of Arjuna, of Satyaki, and of the Kurus, is lying on the ground.

sa: अमित्रोपग्रहं चास्य ते कुर्यः क्षिप्रमापदि। संतुष्टाः सर्वतो राजन् राजव्यसनकाक्षिणः॥
en: Watching for the calamities of the king, discontented men promptly side with the latter's enemies, O monarch, in time of danger.

sa: सलिलान्तर्गतः शेते दुर्दर्शः कस्यचित् प्रभो। मानुष्यस्य मनुष्येन्द्र गदाहस्तो जनाधिपः॥
en: Indeed, within those waters lay, O lord, that king, armed with his mace, who, could not be defeated by any man.

sa: शूराः किङ्किणीजालैः समाच्छन्ना बभासिरे॥ त्रैलोक्यविजये युक्ता यथा दैतेयदानवाः। ते
en: On their cars adorned with rows of bells, those heroes shone like Daityas and Danavas desirous of conquering the three worlds.

sa: दिष्ट्या दुर्योधनः पापो निहतः सानुगो युधि। द्रौपद्याः केशपाशस्य दिष्ट्या त्वं पदवीं गतः॥
en: By good luck, O king, the sinful Duryodhana has been killed with all his followers. By good luck, you too, like Draupadi's locks, have regained your normal position.

sa: हादिक्यं च महेष्वाससमर्जुनः शत्रुसैन्यहा॥ संशप्तकगणांश्चैव वेगितोऽभिविदुद्रुवे।
en: Arjuna, the slayer of foes, rushed against that great bowman, Kritavarman and the Samsaptakas.

sa: स ददर्श श्वमांसस्य कुतन्त्री विवतां मुनिः। चाण्डालस्य गृहे राजन् सद्यः शस्त्रहतस्य वै॥
en: He saw, O king, a huge piece of flesh, of a dog that had recently been killed with a weapon, spread on the floor of a Chandala's hut.

sa: स केतुमेकेन शरेण विद्ध्वा शल्यं चतुभिस्त्रिभिरेव कर्णम्॥ ततः स मुक्तैर्दशभिर्जघान सभापति काजच्नवर्मनद्धम्।
en: Piercing Susena with one, Shalya with four and Karna with three, he with the other ten slew Sabhapati (a Kanrada prince) who was cased in a golden armour.

sa: येऽपि सम्भिन्नमर्यादा नास्तिका वेदनिन्दकाः। तेऽपि भोगाय कल्पन्ते दण्डेनाशु निपीडिताः॥
en: By chastisement the violators of laws, the atheists and scoffers of the Vedas, soon become disposed to observe rules and regulations.

sa: समाश्वास्य च गान्धारी धृतराष्ट्रं च माधवः॥ द्रौणिसंकल्पितं भावमवबुद्ध्यत् केशवः।
en: Having comforted Gandhari and Dhritarashtra, Keshava of Madhu's race, came to know the evil that was thought of by Drona's son.

sa: न दिशः सम्प्रजानामि नाकाशं न च मेदिनीम्। केवलं तव वीर्येण तिष्ठामि मधुसूदन॥
en: I cannot any longer decipher the points of the compass, nor distinguish the sky from the earth. Through your energy, O slayer of Madhu, I am only alive.

sa: य एवं व्यूहते राजा स नित्यं जयति द्विषः। तस्मादेवं विधातव्यं नित्यमेव युधिष्ठिर॥
en: That king, who makes his battle array in this way, always succeeds in defeating his enemies. Therefore, O Yudhishthira, the array of battle should always be formed thus.

sa: ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थश्च वानप्रस्थश्च भिक्षुकः। दण्डस्यैव भयादेते मनुष्या वर्त्मनि स्थिताः॥
en: The Brahmacharin and the householder, the hermit and the religious mendicant, all follow their respective duties through fear of chastisement only.

sa: यत्र श्यामो लोहिताक्षो दण्डश्चरति सूद्यतः। प्रजास्तत्र न मुह्यन्ते नेता चेत् साधु पश्यति॥
en: The subjects never forget their duties, where Chastisement, of dark complexion and red eyes, stand ready (to grapple with every offender) and the king is of righteous vision.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं केशवः परवीरहा। जगाम शिविरं सायं पूज्यमानोऽथ पाण्डवैः॥
en: Having said these words, Keshava, that slayer of hostile heroes, went to his tent in the evening adored by the Pandavas.

sa: शापस्यान्तो भवेद् ब्रह्मन्नित्येवं तमथाब्रवम्। भविता भार्गवाद् रामादिति मामब्रवीद् भृगुः॥
en: I then begged him, saying-When, O Brahmana, will this curse end?-Bhrigu replied, saying-This curse shall end through Rama of my family.

sa: सोऽहमेनां गतिं प्राप्तो यथा न कुशलं तथा त्वया साधो समागम्य विमुक्तः पापयोनितः॥
en: It was for this I had led a life like one of uncleaned soul! O righteous one, by you, however, I have been rescued from that sinful life.

sa: ते हयाः पाण्डुरा राजन् वहन्तोऽर्जुनमाहवे। दिक्षु सर्वास्वदृश्यन्त दाशार्हेण प्रचोदिताः॥
en: Those white horses, O king, bearing Arjuna in battle, were seen moving about on all sides urged by the Dasharha heroe.

sa: तयोर्दैवं विनिश्चित्य स्वयं चैव प्रवर्तते। प्राज्ञाः पुरुषकारेषु वर्तन्ते दाक्ष्यमाश्रिताः॥
en: Sometimes, having settled a course of events, destiny acts of itself. For all that, the wise, always take recourse to manliness.

sa: त्रिदिवं प्राप्य शक्रस्य स्वर्गलोके विमत्सराः। वसन्ति शाश्वतान् वर्षाञ्जना दुष्करकारिणः॥
en: Shorn pride, those achievers of the most difficult feats attain to heaven and live for ever in the regions of Shakra!

sa: आधेयं तु मया भूयो यशस्तव महाद्युते। ततो मे विपुला बुद्धिस्त्वयि भीष्म समर्पिता॥
en: I have, however, resolved to enhance your fame, O you of great splendour. It is for this, O Bhishma, that I have just filled you with great intelligence.

sa: कीर्तिं पुण्यं यशो लोकान् प्राप्स्यसे राजसत्तम॥ सर्वे तस्यादृता लोका यस्यैते त्रय आदृताः।
en: By acting thus, O best of kings, you may acquire fame, merit, honour, and blessed regions hereafter. He, who honours these three is honoured of all the worlds.

sa: परित्यज्य च पाञ्चाल्यं प्रयाता यत्र सौबलः। राज्ञोऽदर्शनसंविग्ना वर्तमाने जनक्षये॥
en: Leaving the prince of the Panchalas they proceeded where Subala's son was, anxious to see the king during that terrible onslaught.

sa: विश्वासं चात्र गच्छन्ति सर्वभूतानि भारत। विश्वस्तः शक्यते भोक्तुं यथाकाममुपस्थितः॥
en: All creatures also, O Bharata, trust such a king. Winning their confidence, he succeeds in enjoying the Earth as he pleases.

sa: यां गतिं क्षत्रियस्याहुः प्रशस्तां परमर्षयः। हतस्याभिमुखस्याजौ प्राप्तस्त्वमसि तां गतिम्॥
en: You have achieved that end which Rishis consider to be the mate of a Kshatriya killed in battle facing the foe.

sa: निहत्य गदया पापमिमं कुरुकुलाधमम्। अद्य कीर्तिमयीं मालां प्रतिमोक्ष्याम्यहं त्वयि॥
en: Killing with my mace this sinful wretch of Kuru's race, I shall to-day, place around your neck the garland of Fame!

sa: यस्त्वमित्रेण संदध्यान्मित्रेण च विरुद्ध्यते। अर्थयुक्तिं समालोक्य सुमहद् विन्दते फलम्॥
en: He, again, who makes peace with enemies and falls out with even friends after carefully considering all circumstances, acquires great fruits.

sa: अहतांस्तु महाबाहो शृणु मे तत्र माधव॥ धार्तराष्ट्रबले शेषास्त्रयः समितिमर्दनाः।
en: Listen now to me, O Madhava, about those that yet alive! In the army of Dhritarashtra's son, only three yet survive.

sa: स च सेनापतिः क्षुद्रो हतः सार्धं शिखण्डिना। तेन मन्ये मघवता सममात्मानमद्य वै॥
en: You have killed that mean wretch, viz., Dhrishtadyumna, who was the Commander of the Pandava forces, as also Shikhandin. For this I regard myself equal to Indra himself.

sa: भारद्वाजस्य हन्तारं भूरिवीर्यपराक्रमम्॥ दुर्योधनो महाराज धृष्टद्युम्नमयोधयत्।
en: Duryodhana, O king, fought with heroic and powerful Dhrishtadyumna, the slayer of Bharadvaja's son.

sa: तथैव चरतो मार्गन् मण्डलेषु महात्मनः। विद्युदभ्रप्रतीकाशा भीमस्य शुशुभे गदा॥
en: The mace of the great Bhima, as he moved about in circles, looked like lighting in the midst of the clouds.

sa: निवृत्तं चास्थितो धर्मं क्षमी भागवतः प्रभुः। निवृत्तिधर्मान् विदधे स एव भगवान् प्रभुः॥
en: Endued with forgiveness, he has adopted, again, the Religion of Renunciation. Indeed, it is that holy and powerful one who has himself laid down the duties of Renunciation.

sa: दुर्वाचा निग्रहो दण्डो हिरण्यबहुलस्तथा॥ व्यङ्गता च शरीरस्य वधो वानल्पकारणात्।
en: Some should be punished with rebukes, fines and forfeitures. Loss of limb or death should never be inflicted for slight offences.

sa: अथास्य बुद्धिरभवद् विधिनाहं वजाघनीम्। भक्षयामि यथाकामं पूर्वं संतर्घ्य देवताः॥
en: He thought that having first duly pleased the gods, he should then eat that haunch of dog's meat at his pleasure.

sa: येषां चैकान्तभावेन स्वभावात् कारणं मतम्। पूत्वा तृणमिषीकां वा ते लभन्ते न किंचन॥
en: They again, who firinly believe that all Cause is due to the Nature of things, cannot acquire any truth by even listening to learned 17en or the Rishis.

sa: पञ्चविंशति तत्त्वानि तुल्यान्युभयतः समम्। योगे सांख्येऽपि च तथा विशेषं तत्र मे शृणु।॥
en: In both the Yoga and the Sankhya systems, twenty-five subjects of knowledge have been treated in nearly the same way. Here me as I describe their chief characteristics.

sa: अहं तु तावत् पश्यामि कर्म यद् वर्तते कृतम्। गुणयुक्तं प्रकाशं वा पापेनानुपसंहितम्॥
en: But I hold that whatever acts are done, be they righteous or sinful, be they done knowingly or otherwise, they remain till their fruits are enjoyed or endured.

sa: ततो विग्रहवन्तौ तौ वेदान् दृष्ट्वासुरोत्तमौ। सहसा जगृहतुर्वेदान् ब्रह्मणः पश्यतस्तदा॥
en: Those two foremost of Asuras, having bodies, seeing the four Vedas, suddenly seized them in the very presence of their Creator.

sa: राक्षसाधिपतिर्वीरो विरूपाक्ष इति श्रुतः। स त्वां त्वरति वै द्रष्टुं तत् क्षिप्रं संविधीयताम्॥
en: You may have heard of the king of the Rakshasas, Virupaksha by name, endued with great courage. He is impatient of seeing you! Come quickly and delay not.

sa: इति चिन्ताविविक्तस्य तमर्थे ज्ञातुमिच्छतः। व्यगच्छत् तदहःशेषं मनसा व्याकुलेन तु॥
en: Thinking thus in his heart and curious to know the reason the Rishi passed the rest of that day in anxiety.

sa: स एवं भगवांस्तत्र पूज्यमानः सुरर्षिभिः। देवैश्च सुमहातेजा महादेवो व्यतिष्ठत॥
en: Thus worshipped by the celestial Rishis and the gods, the illustrious Mahadeva of great energy lived on that summit of Meru.

sa: दर्पः क्रोधो मदः स्वप्नो हर्षः शोकोऽतिमानिता। एव एव हि कौरव्य दृश्यन्ते लुब्धबुद्धिषु॥
en: Pride, anger, arrogance, insensibility, fits of joy and sorrow, and self-conceit, all these, O descendant of Kuru, are to be seen in persons under the influence of covetousness.

sa: तासां दर्पः समभवत् प्रजानां धर्मनाशनः। दर्पात्मनां ततः पश्चात् क्रोधस्तासामजायत।॥
en: Then was pride generated in men which is so destructive of virtue. From pride originated arrogance, and from arrogance originated anger.

sa: ततस्तेनाग्निना दग्धो लुब्धको नष्टकल्मषः। जगाम परमां सिद्धिं ततो भरतसत्तम॥
en: Consumed by that fire the fowler became purged of all his sins and acquired, O best of the Bharatas, high success.

sa: यतः सर्वाः प्रवर्तन्ते सर्गप्रलयविक्रियाः। यच्च शंसन्ति शास्त्रेषु वदन्ति परमर्षयः॥
en: From it originate creation and destruction and all metamorphoses. The great Rishis speak of it and praise it in the scriptures.

sa: तेषां लोका ह्यपर्यन्ता: सदने ब्रह्मणा सह। उपस्थिताश्चाप्सरोभिः परियान्ति दिवौकसः॥
en: Such men acquires numberless blessed regions in next life. The gods and the Apsaras with Brahman himself, come to their homes.

sa: भीष्म उवाच भीष्म अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। प्रजारनामनुकम्पार्थं गीतं राज्ञा विचख्नुना॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited an old discourse of what was recited by king Vicharakhu through pity for all creatures.

sa: तत्र स्म मत्तमातङ्गा धर्मार्ताः श्रमकर्शिताः। विश्राम्यन्ति महाबाहो तथान्या मृगजातयः॥
en: Under his shade elephants, exhausted and covered with temporal juice and sweat, used to rest, and as also many other animals.

sa: यां यामिच्छेत् तनुं देवः कर्तुं कार्यविधौ क्वचित्। तां तां कुर्याद् विकुर्वाणः स्वयमात्मानमात्मना।॥
en: Whatever forms the Supreme Deity wishes to assume with a view to the governing of the affairs of the universe, he assumes immediately by his own inherent powers.

sa: तथा श्वेतस्य राजर्षेर्बालो दृष्टान्तमागतः। श्वेतेन धर्मनिष्ठेन मृतः संजीवितः पुनः॥
en: Likewise the son of the royal sage Shveta had died (prematurely). But the virtuous monarch succeeded in reviving his dead child.

sa: कुरुष्वानुग्रहं सौम्य सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते। निश्चिता खलु मे बुद्धिरतिथिप्रतिपूजने॥
en: O amiable one, be kind to me. To tell you the truth my heart is bent upon honouring you my guest.

sa: एवं स गौतमः पुत्रं प्रीतिहर्षगुणैर्युतः। अभिनन्द्य महाप्राज्ञ इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then, filled with joy and contented with what had taken place, Gautama, O you of great Wisdom, said to his son.

sa: एवं ध्यात्वानुपश्यन्तः संत्यजेयुः शुभाशुभम्। परां गतिमभीप्सन्तो यतयः संयमे रताः॥
en: Thinking in this way and seeing these faults, Yatis, who seek the highest end, follow Yoga, leaving both good and ill.

sa: बहूनीन्द्रसहस्राणि दैवतानां युगे युगे। अभ्यतीतानि कालेन कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः॥
en: In time's course many thousands of Indras and of gods have been swept off cycle after cycle. Time, Indeed, is irresistible.

sa: क्षेमैर्गमिष्यसि गृहं श्रमश्च न भविष्यति। कन्यां प्राप्स्यसि तां विप्र पुत्रिणी च भविष्यति॥
en: You will return home safely. Your journey back will not be toilsome. You will get for wife the girl you have chosen. She will bear you a son.

sa: तस्मात् पापं न सेवेत कर्म दुःखफलोदयम्॥
en: Hence, one should never commit sinful deeds which have for their fruit only sorrow.

sa: निवृत्तिः कर्मणः पापात् सततं पुण्यशीलता। सवृत्तिः समुदाचारः श्रेय एतदनुत्तमम्॥
en: Abstention from sinful deeds, steady practice of virtue, good conduct, the due observance of all religious duties,—these form the highest good.

sa: क्षत्र सेवते कर्म वेदाध्ययनसंगतः। दानादानरतिर्यस्तु स वै क्षत्रिय उच्यते॥
en: He, who follows the profession of war, who studies the Vedas, who makes gifts and takes wealth, is called a Kshatriya.

sa: भूयस्तु श्रोतुमिच्छामि धर्मार्थसहितं नृप। कथ्यमानं त्वया किञ्चित् तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: I am desirous of again listening to the recital of some history full of religious instruction, and you should satisfy me.

sa: अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो दत्त्वा यः प्रव्रजेद् गृहात्। लोकास्तेजोमयास्तस्य तथाऽऽनन्त्याय कल्पते॥
en: He who leaves his home, having assured all creatures of his perfect harmlessness, acquires many bright and eternal regions of felicity.

sa: प्रतर्दनः काशिपतिः प्रदाय नयने स्वके। ब्राह्मणायातुलां कीर्तिमिह चामुत्र चाश्नुते॥
en: Having given away his very eyes to a Brahmana, Pratarddana, the king of Kasi, enjoyed great fame both here and hereafter.

sa: दमस्तेजो वर्धयति पवित्रं च दम: परम्। विपाप्मा तेजसा युक्तः पुरुषो विन्दते महत्॥
en: Self-control increases (his) energy. Selfcontrol is highly sacred. Through self-control a man becomes purified of all his sins and gifted with energy, and therefore, acquires the highest blessedness.

sa: कौमाराद् यौवनं चापि स्थावीर्यं चापि यौवनात्। अनेन क्रमयोगेन पूर्वं पूर्वं न लभ्यते॥
en: From infancy youth is reached, and from youth, old age. As the creature advances from one stage into another, the from shown in the previous stage becomes changed.

sa: हृष्टे भवति सा हृष्टा दुःखिते मयि दुःखिता। प्रोषिते दीनवदना क्रुद्धे च प्रियवादिनी॥
en: She rejoices when I rejoice, and becomes sorry when I am sorry. She is cheerless when I am away, and she is all sweetness when I am angry.

sa: एतत् सम्प्राप्य हृष्टात्मा दस्योः सर्वं द्विजस्तथा। तस्मिन् गृहवरे राजंस्तया रेमे स गौतमः॥
en: Getting all those things from the robber, the Brahmana become filled with joy. Gautama began to live happily in that big house given to him by the robber.

sa: के वा भुवि चिकित्सन्ते रोगार्तान् मृगपक्षिणः। श्वापदानि दरिद्रांश्च प्रायो नार्ता भवन्ति ते॥
en: When animals and birds and beasts of prey and poor men are attacked by diseases, who treats them with medicines? Indeed, these are not seen to be ill.

sa: मृत्युर्जरा च व्याधिश्च दुःखं चानेककारणम्। अनुषक्तं यदा देहे किं स्वस्थ इव तिष्ठसि॥
en: When death, decrepitude, disease, and grief originating from various causes, are all living in your body, how is it that you live as if you are perfectly hale.

sa: इत्युक्ता तेन विप्रेण राजपुत्री यशस्विनी। विधिना प्रतिजग्राह वेदोक्तेन विशाम्पते॥
en: Thus addressed by that Brahmana, O king, the illustrious princess welcomed him according to the rites laid down in the Vedas.

sa: सोद्यं ब्राह्म तपस्तेपे संहितां संयतो जपन्। तस्य वर्षसहस्रं तु नियमेन तथा गतम्॥
en: He practised, silently reciting the Gayatri, severe austerities for attaining to Brahma. A thousand years passed away while he was engaged in the observance of vows and fasts.

sa: पुत्र उवाच एवमभ्याहते लोके सर्वतः परिवारिते। अमोघासु पतन्तीषु किं धीर इव भाषसे॥
en: The son said, When the world is thus attacked on all sides, and when such irresistible things are falling on all sides, how can you speak so calinly?

sa: एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान् सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभः। ईशानः स वरान् दत्त्वा तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: Having said these words, and granted me these boons, the illustrious Ishana, effulgent like millions of Suns, disappeared there and then.

sa: यथा प्रमाणं हि मया कृतो ब्रह्मा प्रसादतः। रुद्रश्च क्रोधजो विप्रा यूयं प्रकृतयस्तथा॥
en: According to the authority of the scriptures I have created Brahman from the attribute of Grace, Rudra from my anger, and yourselves, ye Brahmanas, as representing the elements.

sa: राजोवाच स्वशक्त्याहं ददानीति त्वया पूर्वमुदाहृतम्। याचे त्वां दीयतां मह्यं जप्यस्यास्य फलं द्विज॥
en: You gave vent to these words first, viz., I shall give you according to my might.-I, therefore, pray, O twice-born one,-Give me the fruits of this your recitation.

sa: ततो देवगणाः सर्वे पितामहमुपाद्रवन्। तत्र गत्वा महात्मानमूचुश्चैव जगत्पतिम्॥ नादोऽयं कीदृशो देव नैतं विद्म वयं प्रभो। कोऽसौ हि कस्य वा नादो येन विह्वलितं जगत्॥ देवाश्च दानवाश्चैव मोहितास्तस्य तेजसा।
en: Going there, those illustrious addressed the Lord of the universe, saying-What sort of noise is this, O powerful one? We do not understand it. Who is this one, ones or whose is this sound by which the universe has been stupefied. With the power of this sound or of its maker, the gods and the Danavas have all been deprived of their senses.

sa: ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते। वाङ्मनोनियमः सम्यमानसं तप उच्यते॥
en: Brahmacharya and abstention from injury form yoga of the body; while restraining of mind and words form yoga of the mind.

sa: दमः क्षमा धृतिस्तेजः संतोषः सत्यवादिता। ह्रीरहिंसाव्यसनिता दाक्ष्यं चेति सुखावहाः॥
en: Self-control, forgiveness, patience, energy, contentment, truthfulness, modesty, abstention from injury, freedom from the evil practices called Vyasana, and cleverness,—these yield happiness.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच इयं वृत्रादनुप्राप्ता पुरुहूतं महाभया। ब्रह्मवध्या चतुर्थांशमस्या यूयं प्रतीच्छत॥
en: Brahman said-This dreadful sin has possessed Indra on account of his having killed Vritra. Take you a fourth part of Brahmanicide.

sa: यदि वा दोषजातं त्वं परदारेषु पश्यसि। आत्मानं स्पर्शयाम्यद्य पाणिं गृह्णीष्व मे द्विज॥
en: If you see sin in knowing one who is not your wife, I yield myself to you. Do you, O twice born one, accept my hand in marriage.

sa: आकाशात् खलु यो घोषः संघातस्तु महीगुणः। वायोः प्राणो रसस्त्वद्भ्यो रूपं तेजस उच्यते॥
en: Verily, sound originates from ether, and all dense matter is the attribute of Earth. Life springs from Wind. Taste is from Water. From is the property of Light.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच के दोषा मनसा त्यक्ताः के बुद्ध्या शिथिलीकृताः। के पुनः पुनरायान्ति के मोहादफला इव॥
en: Yudhishthira said, What eviis are shunned by persons sceking Liberation? What are those that are weakened by them? What are the evils that come again and again? What, again, are regarded as week, through stupefaction.

sa: ऋक्सामसंघांश्च यजूंषि चापि च्छन्दांसि नक्षत्रगति निरुक्तम्। अधीत्य च व्याकरणं सकल्पं शिक्षां च भूतप्रकृतिं न वेदि॥
en: I have read the Riks, all the Samans, all the Yajuses, the Chhandas, Astronomy, Nirukta, Grammar, Sankalpa, and Shiksha. But I have no knowledge of the nature of the five principal elements which forin everything.

sa: य इमां पृथिवीं कृत्स्नामेकच्छत्रां प्रशास्ति ह। एक एव स वै राजा पुरमध्यावसत्युत॥
en: That man who has to rule the entire world must, indeed, be a single king without a second. He is obliged to live in only a single palace.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततः पपात शिरसा ब्राह्मणस्तोयधारिणे। उवाच चैनं धर्मात्मा महान् मेऽनुग्रहः कृतः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed, the pious Brahmana, bending his head to that Cloud, laid himself low on the ground, and said,-You have, indeed, done me a great favour!

sa: कामतो मुच्यमानस्तु धूम्राभ्रादिव चन्द्रमाः। विरजाः कालमाकाङ्क्षन् धीरो धैर्येण वर्तते।॥
en: Shorn of desire like the Moon emerged from clouds, the wise man, purged of all stains, live patiently expecting his time.

sa: अधर्मस्त्रिविधस्तस्य वर्धते रागमोहजः॥ पापं चिन्तयते चैव प्रब्रवीति करोति च।
en: Begotten of attachment and mistake, his sins of three sorts, rapidly multiply for he thinks sinfully, speaks sinfully, and acts sinfully.

sa: जनक उवाच कानि कर्माणि धाणि लोकेऽस्मिन् द्विजसत्तम। न हिंसन्तीह भूतानि क्रियमाणानि सर्वदा॥
en: Janaka said What are those righteous acts in this world, 0 best of all twice-born ones, the accomplishment of which does not inflict any injury upon other creatures?

sa: सुव्यक्तं कारणं ह्यत्र न ते हास्यमकारणम्। कौतूहलं मे सुभृशं तत्त्वेन कथयस्व मे॥
en: There must be some grave reason for your conduct. Your laughter cannot be causeless. I have great curiosity to know the reason. Do you speak truly to me.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इदं द्वैपायनवचो हितमुक्तं निशम्य तु। शुको गतः परित्यज्य पितरं मोक्षदेशिकम्॥
en: Bhishma said-Having heard these wholesome words spoken by the Island-born (Vyasa), "Shuka, leaving his father, proceeded to seek a preceptor who could teach him the religion of Liberation.

sa: न ह्यस्ति सर्वभूतेषु दुःखमस्मिन् कुतः सुखम्। एवं प्रकृतिभूतानां सर्वसंसर्गयायिनाम्॥
en: For all creatures there is in this world neither misery nor happiness. Such is the true nature of all living creatures.

sa: शोकं त्यजत दैन्यं च सुतस्नेहान्निवर्तत। त्यज्यतामयमाकाशे ततः शीघ्रं निवर्तत॥
en: Shake off sorrow and cheerlessness, and abstain from parental affection! Lcave the child on this open ground, and go away forthwith.

sa: सुखसम्भावनं कृत्वा धारयित्वा सुखं स्वयम्। त्यक्त्वा गमिष्यथ क्वाद्य समुत्सृज्याल्पबुद्धिवत्॥
en: Anticipating inconvenience and pain and seeking your own comfort, where will you, like persons of little intelligence, go, leaving this darling.

sa: निरन्तरं च मिश्रं च लभते कर्म पार्थिव। कल्याणं यदि वा पापं न तु नाशोऽस्य विद्यते॥
en: As the fruit of his acts, O king, a person, sometimes acquires happiness wholly, sometimes misery in the same way, and sometimes happiness and misery united together. Whether virtuous or sinful, acts are never destroyed.

sa: सुकृतासुकृतं कर्म निषेव्य विविधैः क्रमैः। दशार्धप्रविभक्तानां भूतानां बहुधा गतिः॥
en: Doing by different means virtuous or sinful acts, living creatures, when dissolved into their five constituent elements, attain to various ends.

sa: आपस्तत्र प्रतिष्ठन्ति उर्मिमत्यो महास्वनाः। सर्वमेवेदमापूर्य तिष्ठन्ति च चरन्ति च॥
en: Water then prevails. Surging into big billows and roaring dreadfully only water fills this space and moves about or stands still.

sa: सर्वे यथार्हदातारः सर्वे विगतमत्सराः॥ सर्वे सर्वेषु भूतेषु यथावत् प्रतिपेदिरे।
en: All of them were liberal giving to each what each deserved. All of them behaved properly and duly by all creatures.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा स तदा विप्रो गौतमो जपतां वरः। अविमृश्य महाभागो वनमेव जगाम सः॥
en: Having said these words without much thought, the learned Gautama, that foremost of persons engaged in the practice of Yoga, that highly blessed ascetic, left for the forest.

sa: निगृहीतेन्द्रियस्यास्य कुर्वाणस्य मनो वशे। देवतास्तत् प्रकाशन्ते हृष्टा यान्ति तमीश्वरम्॥
en: Upon the mind being thus restrained and the senses being all subdued, the senses will shine and gladly enter into Brahma.

sa: ततः प्रभृति चाद्यापि शब्दानुच्चारितान् पृथक्॥ गिरिगह्वरपृष्ठेषु व्याहरन्ति शुकं प्रति।
en: Thereforward, when sounds are made in mountain-caves or on mountain-breasts, the latter, as if in answer to Shuka, still echo them.

sa: तस्मिन् महति संवृत्ते समरे भृशदारुणे॥ बभूव भूः प्रतिभया मांसशोणितकर्दमा।
en: During that dreadful and fierce battle, the Earth was covered with flesh and blood, and dreadful spectacles appeared on all sides.

sa: एष चास्तं गिरिश्रेष्ठं भानुमान् प्रतिपद्यते। चढूंषि सर्वलोकस्य संहरन्निव सर्वथा॥
en: Sun god here has reached now at the best mountain Astacala as if contracting completely the eye-sight of the entire world,

sa: संजय उवाच हन्त तेऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि संग्राम लोमहर्षणम्। यथाभूद् राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सौभद्रस्य च मारिष॥
en: Sanjaya said I shall describe to you, O sire in detail, the hair-string battle that was fought between the prince of the Rakshasas an the son of Subhadra;

sa: अपि चैतन्मया राजन् नारदेऽपि निवेदितम्। व्यासे चैव तथा कार्यं तौ चोभौ मामवोचताम्॥
en: I then informed even Narada, O king, and also Vyasa of the doings (of that daughter of the king of Kashi), and both of them said to me.

sa: दुपस्य सपुत्रस्य विराटस्य च संनिधौ। भूमिपानां च सर्वेषां मध्ये वाक्यं जगाद ह॥
en: And also of Drupada with his son and in the presence of Virata also and in the midst of those rulers of the earth he uttered these words.

sa: स सर्वतः परिवृतस्त्रिगर्तेः सुमहात्मभिः। भ्रातृभिः सह पुत्रैश्च तथान्यैश्च महारथैः॥
en: He was also surrounded on all sides by the Trigartas of high-soul, along with their brothers, sons, and many other car-warrior.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय समरे भारसाधनम्। मद्रेश्वरो रणे जिष्णु ताडयामास रोषितः॥
en: Thereupon taking up another bow capable of bearing great strain, the ruler of the Madras waxing worth, pierced Vishnu in battle,

sa: पूजितश्च प्रतिययौ निर्भय॑ तनयां किल। विनीतकिल्बिषे प्रीते हेमवर्मणि पार्थिवे।
en: And he departed, being worshipped after having rebuked his daughter. After the gladdened king with the golden Armour, on being pacified,

sa: यद्यप्येते न पश्यन्ति लोभोपहतचेतसः। कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं मित्रद्रोहे च पातकम्॥
en: If they, blinded by avarice, cannot see the sin they commit by exterminating the (Kuru) race, and playing enmity with friends.

sa: ततः स्वशिबिरं गत्वा पाण्डवाः कुरवस्तथा। न्यवसन्त महाराज पूजयन्तः परस्परम्॥
en: Then, O mighty monarch, the Pandavas and the Kurus repairing near their respective encampments entered them exchanging greetings with one another.

sa: न माया हीन्द्रजालं वा कुहका वाऽपि भीषणा। आत्तशस्त्रस्य मे युद्ध वहन्ति प्रतिगर्जनाः॥
en: Neither deception, nor illusion, nor the trick of a conjurer is frightful to one who has taken up arms for fight, these only tend to excite his anger.

sa: तामव्रवीच्च कौरव्य मम माता जले स्थिता। किमर्थं क्लिश्यसे भद्रे तथ्यमेव वदस्व मे॥
en: (One day) my mother, (Ganga) while in the waters, spoke these words, O Kaurava why do you take so much pains, O blessed one! Tell me the truth.

sa: संयुगं गच्छ भीष्मेण भिन्धि वा शिरसा गिरिम्। तरेमं वा महागाधं बाहुभ्यां पुरुषोदधिम्॥
en: Go to fight with Bhishma, or rend asunder the mountain by your head or with the help only of your two arms cross the sea of vast expanse,

sa: तद् युधिष्ठिर तुष्टोऽस्मि पूजितश्च त्वयाऽनघ। अनुजानामि युध्यस्व विजयं समवाप्नुहि॥
en: O Yudhishthira, O sinless one, I am now pleased and honoured by you. I give you permission. Fight and win victory.

sa: यथा हि पुरुषः पश्येदादर्श मुखमात्मनः। एवं सुदर्शनद्वीपो दृश्यते चन्द्रमण्डले॥
en: As a man can see his face in a mirror, so is the island called Sudarshana seen in the lunar disc.

sa: केचित् तत्राब्रुवन् राज्ञः पुत्रं गृह्णीम वै स्वयम्॥ सोऽस्याकरः काञ्चनस्य तस्य यत्तं चरामहे।
en: Some of them said. "We shall seize the son of the king. He is the mine of gold of his father. Let us therefore try to seize him."

sa: नारदस्त्वप्रवीदेनं देहि मह्यमिमां नृप। भार्यार्थं सुमहच्छ्रेयः प्राप्तुं चेदिच्छसे नृप॥
en: Thereafter Narada addressed the king saying-"O monarch, if you desire to secure great good, give me this your daughter in marriage.”

sa: वृषसेनाय सौभद्रं शेषाणां च महीक्षिताम्। स समर्थं हि तं मेने पार्थादभ्यधिकं रणे॥
en: The son of Subhadra with Vrishasena and the rest of the rulers of the earth for he regarded him (Abhimanyu) as even superior to Arjuna himself in battle.

sa: शिनेः पौत्रस्य तु रथं परिगृह्य महाद्विपः॥ अभिचिक्षेप वेगेन युयुधानस्त्वपाक्रमत्।
en: Thereat the mighty elephant twining with its trunks the car of Sini's grandson, threw it violently to distance; but Yuyudhana escaped.

sa: यदि त्वं हि पुरा द्यूतात् कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। निवर्तयेथाः पुत्रांश्च न त्वां व्यसनमाव्रजेत्॥
en: If in days gone by, you had prevented Kunti's son Yudhishthira or your own sors, from the tournament at dice, then this calamity would not have overtaken you.

sa: चत्वारि तु सहस्राणि वर्षाणां कुरुसत्तम। आयु:संख्या कृतयुगे संख्याता राजसत्तम॥
en: O foremost of the Kurus, O best of kings, the length of life in the Krita Yoga is four thousand years.

sa: तं चरन्तं रणे पार्था ददृशुः कौरवं युधि। मृगमध्यं प्रविश्येव यथा सिंहशिशुं वने॥
en: The sons of Pritha then beheld that foremost of the Kurus, career on the field of battle, like a lion-cub in the woods amidst a herd of deer.

sa: स शल्यं पञ्चविंशत्या कृपं च नवभिः शरैः। अश्वत्थामानमष्टाभिर्विव्याध पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, he wounded Shalya with twenty-five arrows and Kripa with nine arrows and Ashvathama with eight.

sa: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम्। भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं चसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च॥
en: Who, being undistributed in any thing, remain as if distributed in every thing; who is the sustainer of all beings, and the destroyer and the creator of all;

sa: सृजते च पुनः सर्वं विद्यति नेह शाश्वतम्। नरो नारायणश्चैव सर्वज्ञः सर्वभूतहत्॥ देवा वैकुण्ठमित्याहुनरा विष्णुमिति प्रभुम्॥
en: It is Time that again creates every thing. Nothing is ever-lasting in this world. It is omniscient Nara and Narayana that destroy all creatures. The celestial call Him Vaikuntha, men call Him the Lord Vishnu.

sa: भीष्मस्य समरे कर्म चिन्तयानास्तु पाण्डवाः। नालभन्त तदा शान्ति भीष्मबाणप्रपीडिताः॥
en: The Pandavas, afflicted with the arrows of Bhishma and thinking of the feats achieved in battle, did not obtain any peace.

sa: राम उवाच प्रत्यक्षमेतल्लोकानां सर्वेषामेव भाविनि। यथाशक्त्या मया युद्धं कृतं वै पौरुषं परम्॥
en: Bhishma said In the very sight of all these persons O maiden, I have done better, according to the best of my power, and displayed my highest prowess.

sa: स एष शाश्वतो देवः सर्वगुह्यमयः शिवः। वासुदेव इति ज्ञेयो यन्मां पृच्छसि भारत॥
en: This one is that eternal Deity that pervades all creatures, and is ever blessed. He, of whom you have asked me, is celebrated under the name of Vasudeva.

sa: ते वयं संशयं प्राप्ताः ससैन्याः शत्रुकर्षण। कथमस्मान्महाव्यूहादुस्थानं नो भविष्यति॥
en: O chastiser of foes, we are doubtful of success. How can victory be ours in the face of this (Kuru) army?

sa: श्रुतं हि कुरुमुख्यस्य नाहं हन्यां शिखण्डिनम्। कन्या ह्येषा पुरा भूत्वा पुरुषः समपद्यत॥ इत्येवं निश्चयं कृत्वा पाण्डवाः सहमाधवाः। अनुमान्य महात्मानं प्रययुर्हष्टमानसाः। शयनानि यथास्वानि भेजिरे पुरुषर्षभाः॥
en: I have heard that foremost of the Kurus viz., Bhishma say, 'I will never strike Shikhandin, in as much as formerly born as a daughter he attained manhood subsequently." Having formed this resolution the Pandavas with him of Madhu's race went back to their tents with cheerful hearts, and with the permission of the illustrious Bhishma.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः। स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः॥
en: The great one said He, who performs actions that ought to be performed, regardless of their fruits is a Sanyasi or Yogi, but not he who discard the sacrificial fire and obtains from all actions.

sa: ततोऽवहारं सैन्यानां कृत्वा तत्र महारथाः। न्यवशिन्त कुरुश्रेष्ठ संग्रामे क्षतविक्षताः॥
en: Then the mighty car-warriors, having withdrawn their forces, foremost of the Kurus, entered their tents, with their bodies mangled with wounds.

sa: ममैषः भारः सर्वो हि हनिष्यामि पितामहम्। शपे केशव शस्त्रेण सत्येन सुकृतेन च॥
en: Let all the burden be on me, I will slay the grandsire! Ishvara, O Keshava, o Keshava, by my weapons, by my troth and by iny good achievements,

sa: ततः प्रहस्य समरे भीमसेनः परंतपः। प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धः सायकान् कृतवर्मणे॥
en: Thereupon that scorcher of foes Bhimasena, waxing irascible and smiling the while, shot, in that combat, myriad's of shafts towards Kritavarma.

sa: हयारोहा हयांस्त्यक्त्वा गजारोहाश्च दन्तिनः। अर्जुनस्य भयाद् राजन् समन्ताद् विप्रदुद्रुवुः॥
en: O king, horsemen, urging their horses and elephant-men urging their elephants fled away in all directions from the fear of Arjuna.

sa: न च स्म ते रुजं चक्रुः पितुस्तव जनेश्वर। स्मयमानस्तु गाड्नेयस्तान् बाणाञ्जगृहे तदा॥
en: These shafts, O ruler of men, did not cause any the slightest pain to your father, and then the son of Ganga received those arrows with a smile.

sa: पूजयामासुरव्यचा मधुपर्केण भार्गवम्। अर्चितश्च यथान्यायं न पिसाद सहैव तैः॥
en: Earnestly they adored him of the Bhrigu race, with honey and curds and being duly honored he sat down with them.

sa: मूषिकाणां गणश्चात्र भृशं संक्षीयतेऽथ सः। मार्जारो वर्धते चापि तेजोबलसमन्वितः॥
en: The members of mice began to diminish quickly and the cat too began to grow up endued with strength and energy.

sa: ते चापि रथिनः सर्वे त्वरिताः कृतहस्तवत्। अवाकिरन् बाणजालैस्तत्र कृष्णधनंजयौ॥
en: The warriors of your army then with great lightness of hands, hastily covered Arjuna and Krishna with a net-work of arrows.

sa: द्रोणश्च सोमदत्तश्च बाह्रीकोऽथ जयद्रथः। कृपो भूरिश्रवाः शल्य आवन्त्यः सबृहद्बलः॥
en: Drona and Somadatta, and Balhika and Jayadratha and Kripa and Bhurishravas, Shalya and the two princes of Avanti and also Brihadbala,

sa: संजय उवाच स एवमभ्यनुज्ञातश्चक्रे सनापतिं ततः। द्रोणं तव सुतो राजन् विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥
en: Sanjaya said O monarch, then your son, with the perinission of Drona, made him the commander of his troops, with ceremonies enjoined by the ordinances for such occasions.

sa: श्वेतस्य करनिर्मुक्तां निर्मुक्तोरगसंनिभाम्। अपतत् सहसा राजन् महोल्केव नभस्तलात्॥ ज्वलन्तीमन्तरिक्षे तां ज्वालाभिरिव संवृताम्।
en: Having been furled from Shveta's handthat dart which resembled a snake that had just cast off its slough, fell with great force like a meteor from the sky.

sa: पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया। यस्यान्तः स्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्॥
en: The Supreme Being, O Partha, in which all beings dwell, and by whom an beings are permeated, is to be attained by faith, undirected to any other objects.

sa: नास्मि भीतो महाबाहो सहायार्थश्च नास्ति मे। यथाकामं यथायोगं गच्छ वाऽन्यत्र तिष्ठ वा॥
en: I am not afraid, O you of long arms and I have no necessity for your assistance. Go elsewhere if you please, or remain here if you like.

sa: तुरंग रथिनं नागं पदातिमपि मारिष। विनिर्भिद्य क्षिति जग्मुर्वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः॥
en: Those arrows, O sire, penetrating through horses, car-warriors, elephants and footsoldiers, entered the earth, like snakes entering their holes in ant-hills.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच मन्त्रयस्व महाबाहो हितैषी मम नित्यशः। युध्यस्व कौरवस्यार्थे ममैष सततं वरः॥
en: Yudhishthira said O greatly wise one, desiring my welfare from day to day look after my interest. Fight for the sake of the Kurus, this is my prayer.

sa: जामदग्न्येन मे युद्धमिदं परमदारुणम्। अहानि च बहून्यद्य वर्तते सुमहात्ययम्॥
en: This terrible battle, between myself and Jamadgnya, being as it is of high and mighty consequence, lasted for many a day.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं घोररूपं भयावहम्। तावकानां परेषां च निघ्नतामितरेतरम्॥
en: There raged a fierce and frightening battle between your warriors and those of the enemy, as they smote down one another.

sa: एष विक्रान्तयोधी च चित्रयोधी च सङ्गरे। वीतभीश्चापि ते राजन् शत्रुभिः सह योत्स्यते॥
en: This one is a mighty warrior and knows to fight according to diverse methods in battle; and O king, he will fight with your enemies casting fear aside.

sa: संयुगं गच्छ भीष्मेण भिन्धि वा शिरसा गिरिम्। तरस्व वा महागाधं बाहुभ्यां पुरुषोदधिम्॥
en: Go to fight with Bhishma, or rend asunder the mountain by your head or with the help only of your two arms cross the sea of vast expanse,

sa: तथैव पाण्डवाः शूरा धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्घतः। अभ्यद्रवन् रणे भीष्म व्यादितास्यमिवान्तकम्॥
en: So also the Pandava heroes, Prishata's son Dhrishtadyumna and others, rushed against Bhishma who then resembled Death with mouth wide open.

sa: प्रहरास्मिन् नरव्याघ्र न चेन्मोहाद् विमुह्यसे। यत् पुरा कथितं वीर राज्ञां तेषां समागमे॥
en: Now strike, O foremost of men, or you shall be unconscious being overwhelm by a swoon. O hero, the words you uttered before in the assemblage of kings.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं राज्ञो भरतसत्तम। दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यं भीष्मः शान्तनवोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing, O foremost of the Bharatas, these words of the king, Bhishma the son of Shantanu addressed these words to Duryodhana.

sa: उवाच पार्थं बीभत्सुं निगृह्य रथमुत्तमम्। अयं स कालः सम्प्राप्तः पार्थ यः काक्षितस्तव॥
en: Spoke to Vibhatsu the son of Pritha reining in the excellent chariot he drove, "O Partha, the hour which you so ardently looked forward to, has now arrived.

sa: तेन तेन प्रदहतो भूरिगुल्मतृणदुमान्। यादृशौग्निः समुद्भूतस्तादृक् पार्थो न संशयः॥
en: Fire and wind coursing together, consume numerous copses, creepers and trees in that part of a forest through which they pass.

sa: पार्षतः। एवमुक्त्वा ततः पार्थो ध्यायन्नास्ते महामनाः। चिरमन्तर्मना भूत्वा शोकोपहतचेतनः।
en: Having said this, the high-souled son of Pritha, in great grief, remained silent for a long time in a reflected mood.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तथा प्रमथमानं तं महेष्वासानजिह्मगैः। आर्जुनि मामकाः संख्ये के त्वेनं समवारयन्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said What warriors of my army then tried to resist the son of Arjuna in battle when he was thus crushing my troops with his straight-flying arrows?

sa: तं प्रत्यविध्यद् दशभिश्चित्रसेन: शिलीमुखैः। सत्यव्रतश्च नवभिः पुरुमित्रश्च सप्तभिः॥ स विद्धो विक्षरन् रक्तं शत्रुसंवारणं महत्। चिच्छेद चित्रसेनस्य चित्रं कार्मुकमार्जुनिः॥
en: Chitrasena pierced him in return with ten shafts, Satyavrata with nine, and Purumitra with seven. Thus pierced the son of Arjuna while still shedding blood, severed the beautiful and mighty bow of Chitrasena that was capable to holding the foe at bay.

sa: तावविध्यत् ततो भोजः कृतवर्मा शितैः शरैः। त्रिभिरेव युधामन्युं चतुभिश्चोत्तमौजसम्॥
en: The ruler of the Bhojas Kritavarman then pierced them both with sharp arrows, striking Yudhamanyu with three and Uttamaujas with four.

sa: स सत्यसंघो बलवान् द्रोणः किमकरोद् युधि। दिवि शक्रमिव श्रेष्ठं महामात्रं धनुर्भृताम्॥ के नु तं रौद्रकर्माणं युद्धे प्रत्युद्ययू रथाः। ननु रुक्मरथं दृष्ट्वा प्राद्रवन्ति स्म पाण्डवाः॥
en: What feats did Drona perform in battle, Drona who was endued with great strength and was ever devoted to truth? What car-warriors felled in battle Drona of fierce deeds, that foremost of bowmen, that foremost commanders who was like Shakra himself in heaven? Did the Pandavas fly on all directions sceing him of the golden car?

sa: विनदन्तो महात्मानः कम्पयन्तश्च मेदिनीम्। घट्टयन्तश्च मर्माणि तव पुत्रस्य मारिष॥
en: Those high-souled warriors, uttering leonine roars and shaking the earth with their tread, O sire, agitated the heares of your sons.

sa: संजय उवाच यन्मां पार्थस्य संग्रामे कर्माणि परिपृच्छसि। तच्छृणुष्व महाबाहो पार्थो यदकरोद् रणे॥
en: Sanjaya said As you have enquired of me of the feats of Partha in that battle, hear, O you of mighty arms, what he achieved in that battle.

sa: संरक्ष्यमाणः पार्थेन भीष्मेण च विवर्जितः। यथा न हन्याद् गाङ्गेय दुःशासन तथा कुरु॥
en: O Dushasana, act in such a way that Shikhandin, who is protected by Arjuna and whom Bhishma will avoid may not (finally) kill the son of Ganga (Bhishma).

sa: ते गदे गदिनां श्रेष्ठौ समासाद्य परस्परम्। श्वसन्त्यौनागकन्येव ससृजाते विभावसुम्॥
en: Then those two excellent of maces, clashing against each other, appeared like two fiercely breathing she-snakes and emitted flashes of fire.

sa: प्रीतिमान् हि दृढं कृष्णः पाण्डवेषु यशस्विषु। तस्माद् ब्रवीमि राजेन्द्र शमो भवतु पाण्डवैः॥
en: Towards the Pandavas endued with fame, Krishna bears an unshaken affection. Therefore it is, O foremost of sovereigns, that I advice that peace be concluded with the Pandavas.

sa: अब्रवीद् धर्मराजस्तु धनंजयमिदं वचः। श्रुतं ते पुरुषव्याघ्र द्रोणस्याद्य चिकीर्षितम्॥
en: The very righteous king addressed these words to Dhananjaya-"O foremost of men today you have heard of the design of Drona.

sa: विनिर्जित्य रिपून् वीराः सेनयोरुभयोरपि। व्यदृश्यन्त महामात्रा ग्रहा इव नभस्तले॥
en: O king, vanquishing their adversaries, those foremost of warriors of both the armies looked like the brilliant stars in the sky.

sa: तादडयन्तः शितैः परासैश्चोदयन्तः परस्परम्। ते शूराः पर्यधावन्त कुर्वन्तो महदाकुलम्॥
en: Piercing Iravat with sharp lances and urging their warriors against him, those heroes careered over the field creating a great confusion.

sa: तं प्रयान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः। अवतीर्य रथात् तूर्णं भ्रातृभिः सहितोऽन्वयात्॥
en: Seeing him proceed, the son of Kunti, Dhananjaya, soon alighted from his car and followed him accompanied by all his brothers.

sa: दुःशासनो महाराज पाण्डवं विशिखैस्त्रिभिः॥ वासुदेवं च विंशत्या ताडयामास संयुगे।
en: Then, O monarch, Dushasana wondered the son of Pandu with three shafts in battle, and the soli of Vasudeva with twenty.

sa: तत् तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि महावैशसमच्युत॥ तावकानां परेषा च यथा युद्धमवर्तत।
en: I shall describe to you that wonderful and fearful battle that was fought between your warriors and those of the enemy.

sa: माद्रीपुत्रौ च सम्भ्रान्तौ द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यामताडयत्। ततो भीमो महाबाहुर्दृष्ट्वा राजानमाहवे॥
en: He also wounded the two terrified sons of Madri with two shafts cach. Thereupon the mighty armed Bhima, beholding the king,

sa: गदाभिरसिभिः प्रासैर्बाणैश्च नतपर्वभिः। जघ्नुः परस्परं तत्र क्षत्रियाः काल आगते॥
en: The Kshatriya, urged on by Destiny, began to slay one another in that battle, with maces, swerds, lances and straight-jointed shafts.

sa: जधान चतुरो वाहान् सारथिं ध्वजमेव च। सप्तमेन च भल्लेन नीलं विव्याध वक्षसि॥
en: He (Drona's son) slew with these the four horses of Nila and cut down his standard too. With the seventh arrow, he pierced Nila himself on the chest.

sa: स्वर्गमेष गतः शूरः शत्रून् हत्वा बहून् रणे। अबालसदृशं कर्म कृत्वा वै पुरुषोत्तमः॥
en: This hero (Abhimanyu), this foremost of all male beings, has attained paradise after having slain numerous enemies in batile and having achieved many feats not at all boy-like.

sa: भीष्मो यदकरोत् कर्म समरे संजयारिहा। दुर्योधनहितार्थाय के तस्यास्य पुरोऽभवन्॥
en: Who were in his front when that chastiser of foes Bhishma achieved great feats in battle for the good of Duryodhana?

sa: ततः सर्वाणि सैन्यानि सेनामुख्याश्च सर्वशः। प्राद्रवन्त हतं दृष्ट्वा श्रुतायुधमरिंदमम्॥
en: Then beholding that subduer of foes slain all the troops and their leading warriors began to fly away in all directions.

sa: निर्जित्य धार्तराष्ट्रांस्तु पाण्डवेया महारथाः। व्यरोचन्त रणे राजन् दीप्यमाना इवाग्नयः॥
en: The mighty warriors, Oking, of the Pandava host having vanquished, in battle, the army of Dhritarashtra, appeared effulgent like blazing fires.

sa: कुर्वाणौ सुमहत् कर्म भीमसेनघटोत्कचौ। दुर्योधनस्ततोऽभ्येत्य तावुभावप्यवारयत्॥
en: Bhimasena and Ghatotkacha both performed great feats. Then Duryodhana came and checked them both.

sa: शाल्वाश्रयास्त्रिगर्ताश्च अम्बष्ठाः केकयैः सह॥ सर्व एते महात्मानः शरार्ता व्रणपीडिताः।
en: The Shalvas, Shakas, the Trigartas, the Ambashta, the Kaikeyas, all these illustrious warriors, afflicted with shafts, and pained with thcir cuts,

sa: गम्भीरघोषाश्च महास्वनाश्च शङ्खा मृदङ्गाश्च नदन्ति यत्र। विशुद्धरश्मिस्तपनः शशी च जयस्यैतद् भाविनो रूपमाहुः॥
en: The conchs and cymbals produce deep and loud sounds, the sun and the moon give forth pure rays. These are said to be the indications of future success.

sa: तान्यनीकान्यनीकेषु समसज्जन्त भारत। तावकानां परेषां च दृष्ट्वा शान्तनवं रणे॥
en: Beholding Shantanu's son in battle, the divisions of your army and those of the enemy clashed against one another, O Bharata.

sa: ते वध्यमानाः समरे रथिनः सादिनस्तथा। पादाता दन्तिनश्चैव चक्रुरार्तस्वरं महत्॥
en: The car-warrior the cavalry-soldiers the foot-soldiers and the tuskers, being thus slaughtered in the fight, began to utter loud distressful cries.

sa: स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते। लभते च ततः कामान् मयैव विहितान् हि तान्॥
en: endued with this faith, such a worshiper adore the deity (in that form), and obtains from it all that he desires, though they are really given by Me.

sa: किं न पश्यसि बाणौधान् क्रोशमाने किरीटिनः। पश्चाद् रथस्य पतितान् क्षिप्ताशीघ्रं हि गच्छत॥
en: Can you not see the innumerable arrows shot by the diadem-decked Arjuna with his Gandiva bow, are falling full two miles behind his car as he is advancing?

sa: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय। निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत अर्ध्वं न संशयः॥
en: Fix your mind on Me alone, place your understanding also on Me, you will thus, after death, live in Me; there is not the least doubt in it.

sa: सम्मुह्यति तदा सैन्ये त्वरमाणो धनंजयः। भीष्मं शरसहस्रेण विव्याध रणमूर्धनि॥
en: Upon the confusion of the the force, Dhananjaya proceeding heavily, pierced Bhishma with a thousand shafts, at the van of battle.

sa: क्वं तदा गाण्डिवं तेऽभूद् यत् त्वं दासपणैर्जितः। क्वं तदा भीमसेनस्य बलमासीच्च फाल्गुन॥
en: Where was your Gandiva bow when you were defeated at a game of dice and made a slave? And where again was the strength of Bhimasena, O Falguna?

sa: भूर्दिशश्चान्तरिक्षं च शब्देनासीत् समावृतम्। स मुहूर्ते प्रतिभयो दारुणः समपद्यत॥
en: The earth, the points of the compass and the welkin, became completely filled. The hour appeared to be awful and solemn.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्ततो राजन् पाण्डवश्च युधिष्ठिरः। श्रुत्वा भीष्मस्य तां वाचं चोदयामासतुर्बलम्॥
en: Thereupon, o king, Dhrishtadyumna and Yudhishthira the son of Pandu, having heard those words of Bhishma urged on their forces saying:

sa: तमुपायं न पश्यामि जीयेरन् येन पाण्डवाः न्। मामका विजयं युद्धे प्राप्नुयुर्येन संजय॥
en: I could discover no measure by which the Pandavas could be reduced, also by which, O Sanjaya, my sons would be able to secure victory in this battle.

sa: ततः शरसहस्राणि प्रापतन्नर्जुनं प्रति। भ्रमराणामिव वाताः फुल्लं दुमगणं वने॥
en: Then those thousands of arrows fell upon Arjuna like hosts of bees falling, in a forest, on trees decked with blossoms.

sa: कालोऽयं पुत्ररूपेण तव जातो विशाम्पते। न वधः पूज्यते वेदे हितं नैव कथंचन॥
en: O king, Death himself, has taken birth in the form of your son. Slaughter is never spoken high of in the Vedas. It can never produce any good.

sa: श्रुतायुधश्चित्रसेनः पुरुमित्रो विविंशतिः॥ शल्यो भूरिश्रवाश्चैव विकर्णश्च महारथः। एते सप्त महेष्वासा द्रोणपुत्रपुरोगमाः ॥ स्यन्दनैर्वरवर्माणो भीष्मस्यासन् पुरोगमाः।
en: Shrutayudha, Chitrasena, Purumitra, Vivinshati, Shalya, Bhurishrava, and the carwarriors Vikarna. These seven great bowmen clad in excellent armour and riding on their excellent cars followed the son of Drona but marched in front of Bhishma.

sa: संरक्ष्यमाणः पार्थेन भीष्मेण च विवर्जितः। यथा न हन्याद् गाङ्गेय दुःशासन तथा कुरु॥
en: O Dushasana, act in such a way that Shikhandin, who is protected by Arjuna and whom Bhishma will avoid may not (finally) kill the son of Ganga (Bhishma).

sa: सात्यकिः कृतवर्माणं विद्ध्वा पञ्चभिराशुगैः। अतिष्ठदाहवे शूरः किरन् बाणान् सहस्रशः॥
en: Then the heroic Satyaki piercing Kritavarina with five swift-coursing arrows stood in the field shooting shafts by hundreds and by thousands.

sa: प्रत्युत्थानं च कृष्णस्य सर्वावस्थो धनंजयः। न लोपयति धर्मात्मा भक्त्या प्रेम्णा च सर्वदा॥
en: The pious-souled Dhananjaya through the love and venevation he bore for Krishna, never failed under any circumstance, to rise up and advance a few steps for welcoming him.

sa: तन्मया त्वत्कृते चैतदन्यथा व्यपनामितम्। विमुक्तं परमास्त्रेण जहि पार्थ महासुरम्॥
en: For your sake therefore, O Arjuna, I did baffle the weapon. Now slay the mighty Asura deprived of his excellent weapon.

sa: ततो भीमो महाबाहुः सहसाऽभ्यपतद् बली। साहाय्यकारी समरे पार्षतस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Then the greatly strong and mighty Bhimasena soon came there with the desire of helping the Prishata prince in that combat.

sa: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः। निबन्धन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्॥
en: Sattva, Raja and Tama, these three qualities of Nature, O mighty-armed, bind down the Eternal Self in the body of beings.

sa: ते द्रोणमभिवर्तन्ते सर्वतः कुरुपुङ्गवाः । वृकोदरं परीप्सन्तः सूर्यमभ्रगणा इव॥
en: Those foreinost of the Kurus desirous of supporting Vrikodara and surrounding Drona on all sides, like the clouds surrounding the sun.

sa: शप्त्वाथ शपथान् घोरान् सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः। गत्वा दौर्योधनं सैन्यं किं वै वक्ष्यथ मुख्यशः॥
en: Having taken dreadful oaths before the eyes of the entire troops, what shall you say to the leaders of Duryodhana's army if now you go back to them?

sa: चेकितानः स्वसैन्येन महता पार्थिवर्षभ। धृष्टकेतुश्च चेदीनां प्रणेता पार्थिवो ययौ॥
en: And Chekitana, with his own mighty force, O best among kings, and king Dhrishtaketu, the leader of the Chedis, marched forth.

sa: एवमुक्तास्तु ते राजन्नुदक्रोशन् मुहुर्मुहुः। शङ्खांश्च दध्मिरे वीरा हर्षयन्तः परस्परम्॥
en: Thus being spoken to, O monarch. they uttered continuous roars and those heroes blew their conchs imparting delight to one another.

sa: ततस्ते सन्यवर्तन्त संशप्तकगणाः पुनः। नारायणाश्च गोपाला मृत्युं कृत्या निवर्तनम्॥
en: Thereafter that Samshaptaka host once more rallied themselves; and with the Narayana cow-herds, they were determined even to encounter Death himself.

sa: संजय उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा सन्यवर्तत भारत। युधिष्ठिरपुरोगैश्च पाण्डवैः सह संगतः॥
en: Sanjaya said Having heard these words, Krishna stopped. O descendant of Bharata, he then returned to the Pandavas headed by Yudhishthira.

sa: मुमोचास्त्रं महाराज वायव्यं पृतनामुखे। प्रादुरासीत् ततो वायुः क्षोभयाणो नभस्तलम्॥
en: Discharged, O monarch, the Vayavya weapon at the head of the hostile ranks. Thereupon raged a tempest agitation the whole welkin,

sa: संक्रुद्धो वै महाराज दण्डाहत इवोरगः। पौत्रस्तव महाराज तव पौत्रमभाषत।॥
