en: Then that mighty-armed grandson of yours (Abhimanyu), O mighty monarch, excited with rage like a snake struck with a rod, addressing

sa: भूरिश्रवास्तथा शल्यः सोमदत्तश्च वाह्निकः॥ अक्षौहिण्या वृता वीरा दक्षिणं पार्श्वमास्थिताः।
en: Bhurisrava, Shalya and Somadatta as also Vahlika, these heroes surrounded by a Akshauhini of soldiers stationed themselves in the right flank.

sa: दुः:शासनस्तु संक्रुद्धः प्रभिन्न इव कुञ्जरः। अयोधयत सौभद्रमभिमन्युश्च तं रणे॥
en: Then like an elephant with its ternples rent, Dushasana infuriate with rage, fought on with Abhimanyu the illustrious son of Subhadra.

sa: ततः शान्तनवो भीष्मो बीभत्सु नात्यवर्तत॥ अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या क्षुद्रकाणां समाप्रयत्।
en: Thereupon Bhishma the son of Shantanu did no longer assail Vibhatsu; then the latter pierced the former with twenty-five small arrows.

sa: नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाकृतेनेह कश्चन। न चास्य सर्वभूतेषु कश्चिदर्थव्यपाश्रयः॥
en: He has no concern in actions done or not done in this world. Not has he any dependence on any being.

sa: तं प्रत्यविध्यद् दशभिर्भीष्मः शान्तनवस्तदा॥ आजघान ततो भीष्मं श्वेतः क्षत्रियनन्दनः।
en: That delighter of the Kshatriyas, Shveta, then struck Bhishma; and the son of Shantanu pierced him in return with ten arrows.

sa: संजय उवाच अभिमन्यू रथोदारः पिशङ्गैस्तुरगोत्तमैः। अभिदुद्राव तेजस्वी दुर्योधनबलं महत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereafter the generous hero Abhimanyu borne by excellent steeds of tawny colour, rushed against the mighty divisions of Duryodhana,

sa: तथा त्रीणि सहस्राणि त्रेतायां मनुजाधिप। द्वे सहस्र द्वापरे तु भुवि तिष्ठति साम्प्रतम्॥
en: O ruler of men, the length of life in Treta is three thousand. In the present age, in this Dvapara, persons remain on earth for two thousand years.

sa: अनुग्राह्याः पाण्डुसुतास्तव नूनं पितामह। यथेमां क्षममे वीर वध्यमानां वरूथिनीम्॥
en: O grandfather, the Pandavas are certainly being favoured by you. O hero, therefore you forgive them this slaughter of my troops.

sa: ते पीड्यमाना द्रोणेन द्रोणानीकं न शक्नुमः। प्रतिवीक्षितुमप्याजौ भेत्तुं तत् कुत एव तु॥
en: My troops then, thus afflicted by Drona, were not even able, in battle, to look at his divisions what to speak of the thought of breaking through them!

sa: पपात महती चोल्का प्राङ्मुखी भरतर्षभ। उद्यन्तं सूर्यमाहत्य व्यशीर्यत महास्वना॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, large meteors fell, and striking the rising sun, they fell in fragments with loud noise.

sa: दिष्टमेतत् पुरा मन्ये न शक्यमतिवर्तितुम्। गमनं तव चेतो हि पौलस्त्यस्य च दर्शनम्॥
en: It is my belief that it was ordained before hand, and is incapable of being altered, viz., his coming here and my seeing Paulastya (the god of wealth).

sa: अर्जुनस्य इमे बाणा नेमे बाणाः शिखण्डिनः॥ कृन्तन्ति मम गात्राणि माघमां सेगवा इव।
en: These are the arrows of Arjuna and not of Shikhandin, arrows that are cutting me to the quick like the bleakness of winter cutting kine to the quick.

sa: कृतवर्मा शिनेः पौत्रं द्रोणं प्रेप्सुं विशाम्पते। पर्यवारयदायान्तं शूरं समरशोभिनम्॥
en: O majesty! The chivalrous and gracious Satyaki was prevented by Kritavarma who was marching ahead with an intention to suppress Drona.

sa: शराणां च सहस्रेण पुनरेव समुद्यतः। सात्यकिश्छादयामास ननाद च महाबलः॥
en: Inflamed with ire, the highly puissant Satyaki once again covered Drona's son with a thousand shafts; and then uttered his war-cry.

sa: अथोपेत्य महाबाहुरभिवाद्य पितामहम्। अतिष्ठत् प्राञ्जलिः प्रह्वः किं करोमीति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon that mighty-armed hero Arjuna approaching and saluting the grandsire stood there with palms folded, and said “What shall I do."

sa: पदातिषु रथाश्वेषु वारणेषु च सर्वशः। तस्य विद्युदिवाभ्रेषु चरन् केतुरदृश्यत॥
en: Like flashes of lightning amid dense masses of clouds, his standard could be seen whirling amongst foot-soldiers, chariots, horses and carwarriors.

sa: विबभौ राक्षसश्रेष्ठः : सज्वाल इव ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज आHशृङ्गिरमर्षणः॥
en: And foremost Rakshasa, appeared beautiful like a mountain on fire. Thereupon, O monarch, the vindictive son of Rishyashringa, waxing worth, a

sa: अताडयन् रणे भीष्मं सहिताः सर्वसृञ्जयाः। स विशीर्णतनुत्राणः पीडितो बहुभिस्तदा॥
en: The Srinjayas united together began to wound Bhishma in battle. Then when his shattered and he himself overwhelmed with many arrows.

sa: आभग्नाः सुमहावातैरशनीभिः समाहताः॥ वृक्षाः पतन्ति चैत्याश्च ग्रामेषु नगरेषु च।
en: Bcing crushed by the high wind and stuck by lightning, sacred and common trees in villages and towns are falling down.

sa: पाण्डवानां कुरूणां व युद्ध लोकभयंकरम्। यदेतत् कत्थनावाक्यं संजयो महदब्रवीत्॥
en: Namely the war between the Pandavas and the Kurus, frightful to the world. Of the very boastful words Sanjaya told me,

sa: धिग् बलं भीमसेनस्य धिक् पार्थस्य धनुष्मताम्। धिग् वीर्यं वृष्णिवीराणां पञ्चालानां च धिग्बलम्।।
en: Fie on the strength of Bhima, fie on the 'bowmanship of Arjuna, fie on the prowess of the Vrishni heroes and fie on the mighty of the Panchalas!

sa: तथैव च पृषत्कानां शतानि नतपर्वणाम्। चिक्षेप कङ्कपत्राणां जामदग्न्यरथं प्रति॥
en: In the same way, I shot a hundred arrows furnished with the wings of a vulture on the son of Jamadagni.

sa: केसरस्याथ मोदाकी परेण तु महापुमान्॥ परिवार्य तु कौरव्य दैर्ध्य ह्रस्वत्वमेव च। जम्बूद्वीपेन संख्यातस्तस्य मध्ये महाद्रुमः॥ शाको नाम महाराज प्रजा तस्य सदानुगा।
en: That of Kesara is called Modaki and that of the next mountain is called Mahapuman. In the midst of that island is a large tree called Shaka. In height and breadth that tree is equal to that of the Jambu tree in Jambudvipa. The people always worship that tree.

sa: तत्र ते पृथिवीपाला यथोत्साहं यथाबलम्। विविशुः शिबिराण्यत्र द्रव्यवन्ति सहस्रशः॥
en: Therein those rulers of earth entered, according to their respective strength and prowess, in camps which abounded in things by thousands.

sa: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च। न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते॥
en: For I am the enjoyer, as well as the giver of fruits of all sacrifices. But they do not know Me truly, and therefore they fall from heaven,.

sa: तवापराधाद् राजानो निहता बहुशो युधि॥ नानादिग्भ्यः समाहूताः सहयाः सरथद्विपाः।
en: Through your fault, in that battle, were slain numerous kings, invited from various countries, with their steeds and elephants and chariots.

sa: पञ्चाला हि जिघांसन्तो द्रोणं संहृष्टचेतसः। अभ्यमुञ्चन्त गर्जन्तः शरवर्षाणि मारिष।॥
en: Filled with delight and a desire for slaying Drona, the Panchalas, O sire, poured showers of arrows and uttered loud war-cries.

sa: अथ तत्रैव संग्रामे वर्तमाने सुदारुणे। अपसव्यं ततश्चक्रे द्रौणिस्तत्र वृकोदरम्॥
en: Then at that moment, in that dreadful battle, the son of Drona made Vrikodara in the field occupy his right position.

sa: प्रतिविन्थ्यो धनुश्छित्त्वा तस्य भारत सायकैः। फञ्चभिर्निशितैर्बाणैरथैनं स हि जनिवान्॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, Prativindhya, having severed his (enemy's) bow with keen arrows, slaughtered him with five well-sharpened shafts.

sa: श्रुतकर्माणमथ वै नाराचेन स्तनान्तरे। बिभेद तरसा शूरस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: O monarch, he, indeed, then pierced Shrutakarman in the chest with a keen shaft immediately; and afterwards uttered him-'wait and wait.'

sa: ब्रुवन्तश्च रणेऽन्योन्यं चेदिपञ्चालसृञ्जयाः। घ्रत द्रोणं मत द्रोणमिति ते द्रोणमभ्ययुः॥
en: The Chedis, the Pandavas and the Panchalas then addressed another saying-Drona is slain, Drona is slain. Thus speaking they assailed Drona.

sa: तस्य तल्लाघवं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणः क्षत्रियमर्दनः। व्यसृजत् सायकांस्तूर्ण शतथोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Beholding that lightness of hands displayed by him, Drona, that crusher of Kshatriyas, began to discharge arrows by hundreds and thousands.

sa: कर्ण उवाच भीमाहितैस्तव रणे स्वप्नेऽपि न विभावितम्। तद् दर्शयसि कस्मान्मे पृष्ठं पार्थदिदृक्षया॥
en: Karna said "O Bhima! your foes never thought of your fighting even in their dreams. Why do you show me your back from a desire for seeing Arjuna.

sa: स तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा हृदयं चाभितौजसः। अभ्यगाद् धरणीं बाणो हंसः पद्मवनं यथा॥
en: Penetrating through the breast plate and the breast of Dhristaketu of infinite energy, that dart entered the carth like a swan diving into a lake overgrown with lotuses.

sa: ततोऽस्य विशिखं तीक्ष्णं विधाय वधकाङ्क्षिणः। प्रेषयामास समरे भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Thereafter the highly puissant son of Bharadvaja shot a shaft for the destruction of Dhristaketu who was striving to slay him.

sa: ततः प्रववृत्ते भूयः संग्रामो राजसत्तम। कर्णस्य पाण्डवानां च यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनः॥
en: Thereupon, O best of monarchs, again the dreadful battle took place between Karna and Pandavas, which aggrandised the kingdom of Yama.

sa: संशप्तकांश्च कौन्तेयः कुरूंश्चापि वृकोदरः। वसुषेणश्च पञ्चालान् क्षणेन व्यधमद् रणे॥
en: Arjuna then in the twinkle of an eye beset the Samasaptakas, while Vrikodara attacked the Kurus and Karna attacked the Panchalas.

sa: ततः प्रवृत्ते युधि सम्प्रहारे भूतानि सर्वाणि सदैवतानि। दिदृक्षमाणानि नरप्रवीरान्॥
en: When that encounter took place many created beings along with the gods and nymphs came there to see the leading heroes.

sa: तदुद्भूतं बलं दृष्ट्वा नागाश्वरथपत्तिमत्। भीमः कर्णे समासाद्य च्छादयामास सायकैः॥
en: Beholding his army teeming with elephants, horses, cars and infantry then agitated, Bhima approaching Karna began to cover him with arrows.

sa: स काङ्क्षन् भीमसनेसर वधं वैकर्तनो भृशम्। शक्तिं कनकवैदूर्यचित्रदण्डां परामृशत्॥
en: Thereupon Vikartana's son longing to compass the slaughter of Bhimasena, took a lance with a staff variegated with gold and lapises.

sa: तमेते विनिवर्तन्ते धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाः। पाञ्चालसृञ्जयानां च पाण्डवानां च ये मुखम्॥
en: The Panchalas, Srinjayas and the eminent warriors of Pandavas including Dhrishtdyumna etc. are also returning for battle in company of Bhimasena.

sa: इति दुर्योधनस्याहमश्रौषं जल्पतो मुहुः। कर्णो हि बलवाञ्छूरो दृढधन्वा जितक्लमः॥
en: I have always heard Duryodhana speak in this strain. Karna is mighty, heroic, a resolute bowman and indefatigable in battle. was

sa: संजय उवाच यस्मिन् महास्त्राणि समर्पितानि चित्राणि शुभ्राणि चतुर्विधानित दिव्यानि राजन् विहितानि चैव द्रोणेन वीरे द्विजसत्तमेन॥
en: Sanjaya said O monarch, the hero-to whom were given the four kinds of brilliant and mighty weapons of innumerable shapes, as well as various other celestial weapons by Drona the best of the regenerate persons.

sa: ततः प्रववृते भीमः संग्रामो लोमहर्षणः। कर्णस्य पाण्डवानां च यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनः॥
en: Then took place a dreadful and hair-stirring battle between Karna and the sons of Pandu which increased the territory of Yama.

sa: तस्य तान् निघ्नतः शत्रून् हेमपृष्ठं महद्धनुः॥ अजस्रं मण्डलीभूतं ददृशुः
en: Then men beheld his mighty bow of golden staff, as he slew his foes, to be always drawn to a circle.

sa: जानते युधि संरब्धा जीवितं परिरक्षितुम्। अहो मम सुतानां हि विपन्नं सूत जीवितम्॥
en: When excited with rage in battle, pays the least regard to his life. Alas, O son of a charioteer, the very lives of my sons are in danger.

sa: पश्य होनं महाबाहो विधुन्वानं महद् धनुः। शरांश्चाशीविषाकारान् विसृजन्तं महारणे॥
en: See, O you of large arms, he is drawing a huge bow shooting, in the great battle, arrows resembling deadly serpents.

sa: ततो विधम्याधिस्थेः शरजालानि पाण्डवः। विव्याध कर्ण विंशत्या पुनरन्यैः शिलाशितैः॥
en: Then that son of Pandu shot net-works of arrows at the son of Adhiratha. He pierced Karna with twenty sharp arrows.

sa: छादयामास समरे द्रोणपुत्रं परंतपः। ततो द्रौणिर्महातेजाः शरवर्षं निहत्य तम्॥
en: That scorcher of foes covered the son of Drona. Then the highly powerful son of Drona baffling that shower of arrows.

sa: अथो स्थान्तरं द्रौणिः समारुह्य परंतपः। सात्यकिं वारयामास किरशरशतान् बहून्॥
en: Thereafter that afflicter of foes, namely, Drona's son, riding on another car proceeded to oppose Satyaki and shot hundreds of arrows.

sa: उलूकस्तु ततो यानादवप्लुत्य विशाम्पते। त्रिगर्तानां बलं तूर्णं जगाम पितृनन्दनः॥
en: Then leaping down from his car O king, Uluka, the joy of his sire, soon advanced against the host of Trigarttas.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तस्मिन्नने प्रतिहते द्रोणे चोपधिना हते। तथा दुर्योधनेनोक्तो द्रौणिः किमकरोत् पुनः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said When Drona had been slain with underhand measures and when that weapon of his son had been baffled, what did Ashvatthman, urged on by Duryodhana do?

sa: ते बद्धाःपादबधेन न शेकुश्चेष्टितुं नृप। ततस्तानवधीत् पार्थः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Having their legs bound down they could make no effort, O king. Then Partha slew them all with his straight arrows.

sa: यथा निर्मथ्यमानस्य सागरस्य तु निःस्वनः। अभवत् तव सैन्यस्य सुमहानद्भुतोपमः॥
en: Like the deep roar of the ocean when it was churned, a tremendous din was then heard in those troops. son

sa: ततः शल्यः प्रहस्येदं कर्ण पुनरुवाच ह॥ रथस्थमतिसंरब्धं युधिष्ठिरवधे धृतम्।
en: Thereupon, Shalya, smiling again said to Karna, who was on the car, worked up with anger and bent upon killing Yudhishthira.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच निवर्तितेषु सैन्येषु द्रोणपुत्रेण संयुगे। भृशं शोकाभितत्पेन पितुर्वधममृष्यता॥
en: Dhritarashtra said When unable to brook the slaughter of his sire and overwhelmed with grief, Drona's son did rally the troops.

sa: संशप्तकानां कदनमकरोद् यत्र पाण्डवः। कोसलानां तथा राजन् नारायणबलस्य च॥
en: O king, there the son of Pandu brought about the destruction of the Samsaptakas, the Kosalas and the army of Narayana.

sa: तेषु प्रद्रवमाणेषु पञ्चालान् सृञ्जयांस्तथा। अयोधयद् रणे द्रोणस्तत्र तत्र पराक्रमी॥
en: When those steeds thus ran away bearing Dhristadyumna away, Drona of great might began to crush the Panchalas and Srinjayas (mercilessly).

sa: अवप्लुत्य रथात् तूर्णं भग्नवेगः पराक्रमी। आरुह्य स्वरथं वीरः प्रगृह्य च महद् धनुः॥
en: Swifty came down from Drona's chariot. That hero of fierce energy was then greatly robbed of his strength. Thereafter ascending his car and taking up a mighty bow.

sa: अकार्यं परमं कृत्वा मिथ्यावादी च पाण्डवः। यो ह्यसौ छानाऽऽचार्यं शस्रं संन्यासयत् तदा॥
en: As also the prevaricating sons of Pandu, who have perpetrated a sinful act. He that caused by an underhand underhand measure, the preceptor to lay aside his weapon.

sa: तमतथ्यभये मग्नो जये सक्तो युधिष्ठिरः। अश्वत्थामानमयोधे हतं दृष्ट्वा महागजम्॥
en: Afraid of tell lies but interested in securing victory, Yudhishthira, then beholding a mighty elephant by name Ashvatthaman slain in battle.

sa: सहस्रं नरसिंहानां द्विसाहस्रं च दन्तिनाम्। द्रोणो ब्रह्मास्रयोगेन प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे॥
en: Then with his Brahma weapon Drona dispatched a thousand foremost heroes and two thousand tusked elephants to the abode of Death.

sa: ततो द्रोणं महाराज पाञ्चाल्यः क्रोधमूर्छितः। आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो नवत्या नतपर्वणाम्॥
en: Then, O mighty monarch, the Panchala prince, overwhelmed with rage, pierced Drona on the breast with ninety shafts of depressed knots.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु तद् राजन् भारद्वाजशिरोऽहरत्। तावकानां महेष्वासः प्रमुखे तत् समाक्षिपत्॥
en: Thereafter, O king, that furied bowman Dhristadyumna, threw that large head of Bharadvaja's son at the front ranks of your troops.

sa: संजय उवाच राजन् संग्राममाश्चर्यं शृणु कीर्तयतो मम। कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च यथा युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: Sanjaya said Hear from me, O king, as I relate to you, the description of the wonderful fight that then took place between the Kuru and the Pandavas.

sa: तेषां छिन्ना महाराज भुजाः कनकभीषणाः। उद्वेष्टन्ते विचेष्टन्तेपतन्त चोत्पतन्ति च॥
en: Cut-off by enemies, the arms of many warriors adorned with golden ornaments fell down on the earth and writhed in agony.

sa: संजय उवाच सात्वतस्य तु तत् कर्म दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनादयः। शैनेयं सर्वतः क्रुद्धा वारयामासुरञ्जसा॥
en: Sanjaya said Then beholding those feats of that one of the Satvata race, Duryodhana and others, filled with rage, quickly encompassed the grandson of Shini on all sides.

sa: यथा सविद्युतो मेघा नदन्तो जलदागमे। तथा रेजुर्महाराज मिश्रिता रणमूर्धनि॥
en: Like roaring clouds surcharged with flashes of lightning at the commencement of the rainy season, Omighty monarch, those steeds mingled together.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नः प्रहस्यान्यत् पुनरादाय कार्मुकम्। शितेन चैनं बाणेन प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Thereupon Dhristadyumna smilingly taking up another bow, pierced Drona in return with a sharp arrows in the centre of his breast.

sa: एष दुर्योधनः कृष्ण द्रोणेन विहितामिमाम्। तिष्ठत्यभीतवत् संख्ये बिभ्रत् कवचधारणाम्॥
en: This Duryodhana, O Krishna, accoutered in this armour by Drona, is standing dauntlessly in battle, cased in this coat of mail.

sa: कर्णो भीमदपासासीद् रथेन महता दुतम्। भीमोऽपि सात्यकेहिं समारुह्य नरर्षभः॥
en: Karna fled away from Bhima being borne hastily on his swift-coursing car. Bhima also, O foremost of men, ascending Satyaki's Vehicle.

sa: ताभ्यां वियति राजेन्द्र विततं भीमदर्शनम्॥ क्रौञ्चपृष्ठारुणं रौद्रं नाणजालं व्यदृश्यता
en: Spread by them, O king, in the sky those rows, shining as the backs of crane, looked exceedingly fierce and terrible.

sa: दृष्ट्वाश्वनरयोधानां विपुलं च क्षयं युधि। पाण्डवेया महाराज नाशशंसुर्जयं तदा॥
en: Beholding the profuse destruction of horses and foot-soldiers in the battle, the Pandava troops, O king, became hopeless regarding their victory.

sa: ध्वजं धनुश्च सूतं च सम्ममर्दाहवे रिपोः॥ रथचक्रं च कर्णस्य बभञ्ज स महाबलः।
en: And therewith crushed the bow, the standard and the charioteer of his opponent in that battle. That mighty hero also shattered one of the wheels of Karna's car.

sa: स त्वमद्य रणं हित्वा भीतो हर्षयसे परान्। विद्रुते त्वयि सैन्यस्य नायके शत्रुसूदन॥
en: But you now, leaving the fight, are affording delight unto your foes. O slayer of foes, when you, the leader of the host are flying away. are 110W

sa: सोऽहं युधिष्ठिरं हत्वा सत्यस्यानृण्यतां गतः। विशोका विज्वरश्चापि भविष्यामि जनार्दन॥
en: O delighter of the Yadus; by slaying Yudhishthira I will thus adhere to truth thereby be free from grief and fever.

sa: अनिश्चयज्ञो हि नरः कार्याकार्यविनिश्चये। अवशो मुह्यते पार्थ यथा त्वं मूढ एव तु॥
en: Persons ignorant of them become benumbed and befooled in discriminating between what ought to be done and what ought not, even as you, O Partha, have been nonplussed.

sa: अप्रियाणां हि वचसां पाण्डवस्य विशेषतः। द्रौपद्याश्च परिक्लेशस्त्वन्मूलो ह्यमवत् पुरा॥
en: It were you who formerly abused the Pandavas in filthy language; you were the cause of all the wocs of Draupadi.

sa: न वा कच्चिदयं कालः प्राप्तः स्यादद्य पश्चिमः। तव चैवास्य शत्रौश्च तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः॥
en: Is not this to be the last time that you shall meet with Duryodhana your foe? Tell me all this; O son of Pritha, for I ask you.

sa: तान् स पञ्चशतान् वीरान् सपताकध्वजायुधान्। पोथयामास गदया भीमो विष्णुरिवासुरान्॥
en: Like Vishnu killing the demons Bhima, with his mace, destroyed those valiant warriors with their drivers, cars, banners, standards and weapons.

sa: ततोऽस्त्रैः परमैर्दिव्यैर्दोणः पार्थमवाकिरत्। यद् यदलं स पार्थाय प्रयुङ्क्ते विजिगीषया॥
en: Thereafter Drona covered Pritha's son with excellent and celestial shafts. Whatever weapon then he shot at Partha, desirous of obtaining victory.

sa: एष कौरवयोधानां कृत्वा घोरमुपद्रवम्। तव प्राणैः प्रियतमः किरीटिन्नेति सात्यकिः॥
en: Inflicting dreadful loss upon the Kauravas, Satyaki dear unto you like your own life, is coming towards you, O diadem-decked one!

sa: तत् ते न प्रत्यसूयामि चन स सर्व विधीयते। प्रभवार्थाय भूतानां धर्मप्रवचन कृतम्॥
en: I do not find fault with the latter, but then everything is not provided for there. The moral precepts have been made for the well-being of the creatures.

sa: वीतभीाघवोपेतः कृतित्वं सम्प्रदर्शयन्। ततो दुर्योधनो राजा सात्वतस्य त्रिभिः शरैः॥
en: Completely fearless and displaying his Tightness of hands and skill in the use of weapons. Thereafter king Duryodhana, with three arrows.

sa: प्रच्छाद्यमानः समरे शरजालैः स वीर्यवान्। असम्भ्रमन् महाराज तावकानवधीद् बहून्॥
en: That valorous hero then covered over with net-work of arrows, O king, began to slay your troops by hundreds, nothing daunted.

sa: सायकैर्वारितश्चापि वर्षमाणो महात्मना। यक्षा नागास्तथा दैत्या ये चान्ये बलगर्विताः॥
en: With his arrows, the high-souled Arjuna then worsted the pouring Indra. Yakshas and the Nagas and the Daityas and other creatures.

sa: पृष्ठतः सात्यकिं यान्तमन्वधावन्नमर्षिणः। अथ शब्दो महानासीत् तव सैन्यस्य मारिष॥
en: Angrily followed Satyaki from behind as he proceeded onwards. Then, O sire, tremendous was the din that arose among your army.

sa: सधनुर्मण्डल: संख्ये तेजोभास्कररश्मिवान्। शरदीवोदितः सूर्यो नृसूर्यो नृसूर्यो विरराज ह॥
en: Himself emitting great effulgence and wielding that bow drawn to a circle in his hands, he appeared like another autumnal sum.

sa: कामं न खलु शक्योऽहं त्वद्विधानां शतैरपि॥ संग्रामाद् विमुखः कर्तुं धर्मज्ञ इव नास्तिकैः।
en: As a pious man is not to be easily pursuaded by atheists so I am not to be dissuaded from this battle by hundreds of persons like you.

sa: कदर्थीकृत्य नः सर्वान् पश्यतः सव्यसाचिनः। निहतो राक्षस: कृष्ण भैमसेनिर्महाबलः॥
en: Putting ourselves to shame and under the very eyes of Savyasachin, O Krishna, Karna has slain the puissant son of Bhimasena.

sa: ज्या तस्य धनुषो दिव्या तथाक्षय्ये महेषुधी। सारथिस्तस्य गोविन्दो मम तादृङ् न विद्यते॥
en: The string of his bow is celestial as also he (Arjuna) has got two inexhaustible quivers. His charioteer is Govinda. But I have got nothing like all these.

sa: ततस्ते पाण्डवा राजशिखण्डी च ससात्यकिः। राधेयात् परिरक्षन्तो राजानं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: With a view to rescue the king from the son of Radha many Pandava warriors, with Shikhandin and Satyaki surrounded him.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच कथमस्मद्धितार्थं ते कैश्च योगैर्जनार्दन। जरासंघप्रभृतयो घातिताः पृथिवीश्वराः॥
en: Arjuna said How, O Janardana and by what measures were those lords of earth Jarasandha and others slain, for our welfare?

sa: प्रोत्साहयन् दुरात्मानं धार्तराष्ट्र सुदुर्मतिम्॥ समिती गर्जते कर्णस्तमद्य जहि भारत।
en: O Bharata, that wicked Karna thus always in the court (of the Kurus) of Dhritarashtra. Do you, therefore, slay him today.

sa: महांश्चटचटाशब्दस्तत्रासीच महाहवे॥ तां प्रेक्ष्य महतीं मायां राक्षसो राक्षसस्य च।
en: Loud clapping sounds were also then heard in that combat. beholding that illusion created by the Rakshasa Alayudha, the cannibal Ghatotkacha.

sa: स तु बाणैर्दिशो राजन्नाच्छाद्य परवीरहा। आजघ्ने सारथिं चास्य सुषेणं च ततस्त्रिभिः॥ चिच्छेद चास्य सुदृढं धनुर्भल्लैस्त्रिभिस्त्रिधा।
en: Then, O king, covering all the quarters with arrows that subduer of hostile heroes killed Sushena's driver, striking Sushena himself with three arrows and then sundered into pieces his highly strong bow with three Bhallas.

sa: अद्य कर्णे हते कृष्ण धार्तराष्ट्राः सराजकाः॥ विद्ववन्तु दिशो भीताः सिंहजस्ता मृगा इव।
en: And as a deer, afraid of the lion, turns its tail, so, O Krishna, let all the Dhartarashtras, today, with the fall of Karna, beat a hasty retreat.

sa: अद्याहमनुगान् कृष्ण कर्णस्य कृपणान् युधि॥ हन्ता ज्वलनसंकाशैः शरैः सर्पविषोपमैः।
en: O Krishna, with shafts blazing like fire, or resembling venomous serpents, today, I will devour all the sunken hosts of Karna.

sa: असन्तस्तु न्यवर्तन्त वेदेभ्य इव नास्तिकाः। नरकं भजमानास्ते प्रत्यपद्यन्त किल्बिषम्॥
en: Like atheists turning away from the Vedas, many ignoble warriors turned away from the fight and thus incurred sin and hell.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तु तव तत् सैन्यं रथाश्वद्विपसंकुलम्। पदातिजनसंपूर्णमब्रवीत् सारर्थि पुनः॥
en: Then holding that army of yours teeming with car-warriors, horses, elephants and footsoldiers, he again addressed his charioteer sayingयदेतन्मेधसंकाशं द्रोणानीकस्य सव्यतः।

sa: रथं ससूतं सहयं च कञ्चित् कश्चिद्रथी मृत्युवशं निनाय। निनाय चाप्येकगजेन कश्चिद् रथान् बहून् मृत्युवशे तथाश्वान्॥
en: Then again some car-warrior in exchanging shots with his enemy made him die a violent death, together with steeds and charioteer, while another warrior riding on his elephant put to death many car-warriors and horsemen.

sa: ततः पाञ्चालमुख्यस्य धृष्टद्युम्नस्य संयुगे। सारथिं चतुरश्वाश्वान् कर्णो विव्याध सायकैः॥
en: Thereafter Karna dispatched the four steeds and charioteer of Dhristadyumna that foremost of the Panchalas, to the dreary abode of Death.

sa: विरथो विधनुष्कश्च सर्वलोकेश्वरः प्रभुः। आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं भास्वरं कृतवर्मणः॥
en: Deprived of his car and his bow, that lord, that ruler of all men, quickly ascended the resplendent car of Kritavarman.

sa: दुःशासनो दुर्विषहः सुबाहुर्दुष्प्रधर्षणः। एते त्वामनुयास्यन्ति पत्तिभिर्बहुभिर्वृताः॥
en: Dushasana Durvishaha, Subahu and Durshpradharshana these supported by numerous of infantry will follow you.

sa: पितरं तु परीप्सन्तः कर्णपुत्राः प्रहारिणः। त्वदीयाश्चारे राजन् वीरा वीरानवारयन्॥
en: To rescue their father, the sons of Karna all of whom were sinless and many heroes of your army resisted them.

sa: कम्पयन्निव घोषेण धनुषो वसुधां बली। सूतपुत्रो महाराज सात्यकि प्रत्ययोधयत्॥
en: That foremost of the Kshatriyas Satyaki, then pierced the lotus-eyed Karna terrifying the Kshatriya warriors with the clatter of his car.

sa: पञ्चालेषु च शूरेषु वध्यमानेषु सायकैः। हाहाकारो महानासीत् पञ्चालानां महाहवे॥
en: The heroic Panchalas being thus killed with arrows there arose lamentations Alas! and Oh of the Panchalas in that great battle.

sa: ततोऽन्यत् सुदृढं चापं पूर्णमायम्य सात्यकिः॥ व्यसृजद् विशिखांस्तूर्णे शतथोऽथ सहस्रशाः।
en: Then taking up and stretching a bow of tougher make, Yuyudhana swiftly discharged at his enemy hundreds and thousands of shafts;

sa: शतानीकोऽथ संक्रुद्धश्चित्रसेनस्य मारिष। जघान चतुरो वाहान् सारथिं च नरोत्तमः॥
en: son The highly powerful Satanika, then inflamed with wrath, destroyed the four horses and also the charioteer of Chitrasena O Bharata.

sa: अदृष्टपूर्वे तद् दृष्ट्वा साधुवादो महानभूत्। सिद्धचारणसंघानां सैनिकानां च सर्वशः॥
en: The Siddhas, the Charanas and the troops present there, beholding that sight unseen before, uttered loud exclamations in praise of Arjuna.

sa: विराटं दुतमायान्तं द्रोणस्य निधनं प्रति। मद्रराजः सुसंक्रुद्धो वारयामास भारत॥
en: 0 Bharata, O great monarch, the king of Madra, inflamed with rage, opposed Virata who was advancing quickly for slaying Drona.

sa: सादिनः सादिभिः सार्धं प्रासशक्त्यष्टिपाणयः। समागच्छन् महाराज विनदन्तः पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: O mighty monarch, taking up lances, darts and swords in their hands and sending forth loud shouts, horsemen closed with horsemen.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच अहमावारयिष्यामि सर्वसैन्यानि केशव। त्वमप्यत्र यथान्यायं कुरु कार्यमनन्तरम्॥
en: Arjuna said O Keshava, I shall hold the whole army in check. Do you duly perform whatever should be done now.

sa: मोहितः शरजालेन कर्तव्यं नाभ्यपद्यता तं तथा विस्थं दृष्ट्वा रथमारोप्य तं तदा॥ अश्वत्थामां महाराज भूयोऽर्जुनमयोधयत्। मद्रराजश्च कौन्तेयमविध्यत् त्रिंशता शरैः॥
en: Confounded with arrowy showers was completely embraced. Beholding him made carless, Ashvatthaman, O monarch, caused him to ride on his own chariot and went on fightin with Arjuna. Then the king of the Madras pierced the son of Kunti with thirty arrows.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय सात्यकिर्वेगवत्तरम्। पञ्चभिः सायकैस्तूर्णं सोमदत्तमविध्यत॥
en: Thereupon Satyaki, taking up a very strong bow, speedily pierced Somadatta with five arrows.

sa: स निहत्य बहूञ्छूरानश्वत्थामा व्यरोचत। युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि भस्म कृत्वेव पावकः॥
en: Having destroyed numerous heroes, Ashvatthama shone like the fire at the end of a Yuga after having consumed all the creatures.

sa: प्रतीची वरुणः पाति पालयानः सुरान् बली। उदीची भगवान् सोमो ब्राह्मणैः सह रक्षति॥
en: The West is ruled over by the powerful Varuna, who is superior to all the gods there. The North is guarded by the Divine along with the Brahmanas.

sa: तत्पञ्चाला: सोमकाश्चापि राजन् कर्णेनाजौ पीडयामानाः शरौघैः। क्रोधाविष्टा विव्यधुस्तं समन्तात् तीक्ष्णैर्बाणैः सूतपुत्रं समेताः॥
en: O monarch, the Panchalas and the Somakas being thus attacked by Karna, fired up with anger and conjointly began to strike Suta's son with arrows from all sides.

sa: ततः शरसहस्राणि कर्णमुक्तानि मारिष। व्ययोजयन्त पञ्चालन् प्राणैः प्राणभृतां वर॥ तत्र शब्दो महानासीत् पञ्चालानां महामते। वध्यतां सूतपुत्रेण मित्रार्थे मित्रगृद्धिना॥
en: Oye of noble mind and best of living beings, when Karna-the son of Suta and protector of his friends, thus desirous to serve his friends, sent thousands of shafts which killed many of the Panchalas, cries, loud from woe, rose among them.

sa: आयान्तं वीक्ष्य कौन्तेयं शक्रं दैत्यचमूमिव। बीभत्सुरपि राजेन्द्र पञ्चालैरभिसंवृतः॥ प्रत्युद्ययौ तदा कर्णं यथा वृत्रं शतक्रतुः ।
en: Seeing that the son of Kunti was coming against them like Shakra against the Daitya force. Then, O king of kings Vibhatsu also surrounded by the Panchalas marched against Karna like Purandara (marching against) Vritra.

sa: तं तत्र भीमं ददृशुः समन्ताद् दौःशासनं तद् रुधिरं पिबन्तम्। सर्वेऽपलायन्त भयाभिपन्ना न वै मनुष्योऽयमिति ब्रुवाणाः॥
en: Those men, who were at that time near Bhima and who saw him thus drink Dusasana's blood being overpowered with fear, fled on all directions saying to each other that he is no human being.

sa: तस्य तुष्टो महादेवो भक्त्या च प्रशमेन च। हृद्गतं चास्य विज्ञाय दर्शयामास शङ्करः॥
en: Mahadeva became highly gratified with him for his devotional performances and coolness of mind and Shankara, becoming conscious of the object in his mind showed himself to him.

sa: अश्वत्थामोवाच तवैतत् क्षम्यतेऽस्माभिः सूतात्मज सुदुर्मते। दर्पमुस्क्तिमेतत् ते फाल्गुनो नाशयिष्यति॥
en: Ashvatthama said 0 charioteer's of wicked understanding, we forgive you of this (fault). Phalguna will destroy this swelling pride of yours.

sa: दिष्ट्या युवां कुशलिनौ संग्रामात् पुनरागतौ। पश्यामि रथिनां श्रेष्ठावुभौ युद्धविशारदौ॥
en: It is pleasing to see you both warriors, best in chariot holders and efficient in war-craft returned safely from the battle-field.

sa: ततो ध्नं स्फाटिकचित्रकचुकं चिच्छेद वीरो नकुलः क्षुरेण। कर्णात्मजस्येष्वसनं च चित्रं भल्लेन जाम्बूनदचित्रनद्धम्॥
en: Then the mighty Nakula, with a razor-like arrow, rent asunder the gem-bedecked banner of his foe and with another flat-faced shaft broke the gold-belted bow of Karna's son.

sa: सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि समाश्वसिहि भारत। हन्तास्मि पाडुतनयान् पञ्चालांश्च समागतान्॥
en: I swear this truly. Reassure your-self O Bharata. I will destroy the sons of Pandu together with all the assembled Panchalas.

sa: केकयाः सृञ्जयाश्चैव पञ्चालाश्च महौजसः। अन्वगच्छन् महाराज मत्स्याश्च सह सात्वतैः॥
en: The Kakeyas, the Srinjayas and the highly energetic Panchalas, O great king, together with the Matsyas and the Sattvata followed suit.

sa: बभ्रमुश्चस्खलुः पेतुः सेदुर्मम्लुश्च भारत॥ तस्मिन् महाभीषण के प्रजानामिव संक्षये।
en: Began to wander or lamp of fall down. Some became paralysed and some became pale. During that terrible carnage of creatures.

sa: अवश्यं तु मया सर्व विज्ञाप्यस्त्वं नराधिपा वासुदेवस्य यद् वाक्यं फाल्गुनस्य च धीमतः॥
en: But, O foremost of men, I think it a duty to remind you of the words which were spoken to me by Vasudeva and the highly intelligent Phalguna.

sa: न मे धनंजयस्यार्थे प्राणा रक्ष्याः कथंचन। त्वत्प्रयुक्तः पुनरहं किं न कुर्यो महाहवे॥
en: For the sake of Dhananjaya, I am ever prepared to sacrifice my life. Commanded by you, what is there that I would not do in this great battle.

sa: विविशुर्धरणीं शीघ्रा रुक्मपुङ्खाः शिलाशिताः। अश्वत्थामा तु संक्रुद्धो लघुहस्तः प्रतापवान्॥
en: And then speedily entered into the earth like serpents (entering) an ant-hill. The lighthanded and powerful Ashvatthama too, excited with wrath.

sa: संजय उवाच एवं संदर्शयन् कृष्णो रणभूमिं किरीटिने। स्वैः समेतः समुदितैः पाञ्चजन्यं व्यनादयत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Krishna, thus showing the field of battle to Kiriti (i.e., Arjuna who wore a coronet) blew his conch Panchajanya before the gladdened army (of the Pandavas).

sa: अपूपान् सक्तुपिण्डांश्चं प्राश्नन्तो मथितान्वितान्। पथि सुप्रबला भूत्वा कदा सम्पततोऽध्वगान्॥ चेलापहारं कुर्वाणस्ताडयिष्याम भूयसः।
en: When shall I, surrounded by my countrymen, muster strong on the high roads, fall upon the passers by, carry away their robes and attires and beat them repeatedly?

sa: आहुरन्योन्यसूक्तानि प्रब्रुवाणा मदोत्कटाः। हे हते हे हतेत्येव स्वामिभर्तृहतेति च॥
en: The fallen Balhika women, unobservant of restrictions even on sacred days, dance and exclaim “Alas! our husband, our lord is dead!"

sa: अद्य ता मधुरा वाचः श्रोतासि मधुसूदन। दिष्ट्या जयसि वार्ष्णेय इति कर्णे निपातिते॥
en: Today after Karna is no more, O Slayer of Madhu, you will hear those pleasant words, i.e. by good fortune, O you of Vrishni's race, you have conquered.

sa: द्रोणमभ्यद्रवन् क्रुद्धाः सहिताः पाण्डुसृञ्जयाः। ये ये प्रमुखतो राजन्नावर्तन्त महारथाः॥
en: The Pandavas and the Srinjayas united together rushed furiously against Drona. (But) O king, all those who confronted that highsouied one.

sa: कुञ्जराश्वमनुष्याणां प्राणान्तकरणी तदा। तस्यां रजन्यां घोरायां नदन्त्यः सर्वतः शिवाः॥
en: And it then prove fatal to elephants horses and men. On that bitchy dark night jackals setting up (terrible) yells everywhere.

sa: हृष्टो दुर्योधनश्चापि दृढमादाय कार्मुकम्॥ तिष्ठा तिष्ठेति राजानं ब्रुवन् पाण्डवमभ्ययात्।
en: Duryodhana too with (great) joy grasping his bow firmly and shouting to the king (Yudhishthira) 'wait', 'wait' rushed against the Pandavas.

sa: शल्य उवाच मा सूतपुत्र दानेन सौवर्णं हस्तिषड्वम्। प्रयच्छ पुरुषायाद्य द्रक्ष्यसि त्वं धनंजयम्॥
en: Shalya said O son of a charioteer, give away to any man a golden car with six bulls as large as the elephants you will see Dhananjaya today.

sa: ततोऽन्तरिक्षे सुरतूर्यनिःस्वनाः ससाधुवादा हृषितैः समीरिताः॥ निपेतुरप्युमपुष्पवृष्टयः सुगन्धिगन्धाः पवनेरिताः शुभाः।
en: Then the good Gods sounded their heavenly drums in praise of Arjuna. Then heaps of sweet scented flowers fell upon Arjuna.

sa: हितार्थं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य ब्रवीमि त्वां न हिंसया। श्रद्धस्वैवं मया प्रोक्तं यदि तेऽस्ति जिजीविषा॥
en: I tell you this for the well-being of Duryodhana and not out of any ill will for you. If you wish to preserve your life obey my words.

sa: दैवमत्र परं स्मृतम्। अजय्यान् पाण्डवान् मन्ये द्रोणेनासविदा मृधे। तथा ह्येनमतिक्रम्य प्रविष्टः श्वेतवाहनः॥
en: In my opinion the Pandavas unconquerable in battle by Drona, (however) skilled in weapons (he may be) in as much as Shetavahena, surpassing him, entered (into our array).

sa: तस्याहवे पौरुषं पाण्डवस्य ब्रूया हृष्टः समितौ क्षत्रियाणाम्॥ किं त्वं मूर्खः प्रसभं मूढचेता ममावोचः पौरुषं फाल्गुनस्या
en: I will myself with pleasure speak of the prowess of Pandava in battle before the assembly of the Kshatriyas. Why do you, a fool as you are, speak of the prowess of Phalguna to me?

sa: कुमारकास्तदा हंसान् दृष्ट्वा काकमथाब्रुवन॥ भवानेव विशिष्टो हि पतत्रिभ्यो विहङ्गम्।
en: Seeing those swans the Vaishya boys said to the crow-"O ranger of the sky, you are superior to all winged creatures."

sa: अस्ति वाऽयमिषुः शल्य सुपुङ्खो रक्तभोजनः। एकतूणीशयः पत्री सुधौत: समलंकृतः॥
en: I have this arrow, O Shalya, keen edged, blood-drinking, occupying alone one quiver, furnished with wings, well-steeped in oil and well-adorned.

sa: प्रावृट्काले कौरव्य भीमसेनस्य संयुगे।॥ तं तस्य निनदं घोरं पार्थः शुश्राव नर्दतः। वासुदेवश्च कौरव्य भीमसेनस्य संयुगे॥
en: Like, O king, the clouds roaring at the rainy seasons. That dreadful roar of the roaring Bhimasena was then heard, O foremost of the Kurus, by Partha and the son of Vasudeva engaged in battle.

sa: असौ हि श्रूयते शब्दः शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम्। मिथः संयुध्यमानानां वृष्णिवीरेण धीमता॥
en: Hark the loud noise of the battle that the unretreating heroes are fighting with that intelligent champion of the Vrishni race!

sa: अथवा धारयिष्यामि क्रोधमद्य निशामिमाम्। गृह्यतामुदयः स्वैरं कामभोगेषु वानर ॥
en: Or I shall suppress my wrath for this night and do you, O monkey, enjoy till the rise of the Sun.

sa: उषित्वा द्वादश समा इक्ष्वाकूणां निवेशने। भुञ्जाना मानुषान् भोगान् सर्वकामसमृद्धिनी॥
en: Dwelling in the palace of Ikşäkus for twelve years, I enjoyed many things passing human and had all my desires satisfied.

sa: उदयात् प्रस्थितं वापि ज्वलन्तं रश्मिमालिनम्। अनस्तमितमादित्यमहं गन्तुं समुत्सहे॥ ततो भूमिमसंस्पृष्ट्वा पुनरागन्तुमुत्सहे। प्रवेगेनैव महता भीमेन प्लवगर्षभाः॥
en: And can touch the flaming effulgent Sun ere, beginning his jour from the Rising hill, he ascends the Setting hill. And, foremost of monkeys, I can, fiercely rushing on, come as without touching the earth.

sa: भवेद्धतोऽयं वातापिरगस्त्येनेव मा गतः। इह त्वं भव संनद्धो यन्त्रितो रक्ष मैथिलीम् ॥
en: Therefore this Mārīca approaching me shall be killed by me like to Vātāpi being devoured by Agastya. Do you therefore vigilantly protect Vaidehi with mail and armours on.

sa: स च श्रीमानचिन्त्यात्मा रामो दशरथात्मजः। सूतं संचोदयामास त्वरितं वाह्यतामिति॥
en: Then the auspicious son of Daśaratha of soul incapable of being comprehended, ordered the charioteer, saying, "Do you proceed more speedily."

sa: पतत्पतङ्गसंकाशो व्यायतः शुशुभे कपिः। प्रवृद्ध इव मातङ्गः कक्ष्यया बध्यमानया॥
en: Then that stalwart monkey resembling the careering sun, resembled a mad elephant fettered by the middle, whose bulk has increased immensely.

sa: तस्य भार्या जनस्थानाद् रावणेन हृता बलात्। रामस्य तु पितुर्मित्रं जटायुर्नाम गृध्रराट्॥ ददर्श सीतां वैदेहीं ह्रियमाणां विहायसा। रावणं विरथं कृत्वा स्थापयित्वा च मैथिलीम्। परिश्रान्तश्च वृद्धश्च रावणेन हतो रणे॥
en: His spouse was forcibly carried away from Janasthāna. And the friend of Rāma's father, the king of vultures, named Jatayu, saw Videha's daughter, Sītā, as she was being carried away in the sky. And after having thrown down Rāvana from his car, and placed Maithili on the ground, (that vulture) old and overcome with fatigue was (at length) slain by Ravana in battle.

sa: कस्य पत्ररथाः कायान्मांसमुत्कृत्य संगताः। प्रहृष्टा भक्षयिष्यन्ति निहतस्य मया रणे॥
en: Tearing off flesh from the corpse of whom slain by me in conflict, shall the birds so joyfully feed on it?

sa: अपि वै तस्य कार्यस्य भवान् मूलमरिंदम। तस्मात् कलत्रवत् तात प्रतिपाल्यः सदा भवान्॥
en: O repressor of oes! O subduer of enemies, you are the root of this business. Therefore, my child, you should always be maintained by us like a wife.

sa: रममाणस्त्वया सार्धं मृत्युं त्वां नाभिलक्षये। बालो रहसि हस्तेन कृष्णसर्पमिवास्पृशम्॥
en: Not knowing you for my death, I have sported with you, like an infant dallying in solitude with a venomous snake.

sa: एवं गृध्रो हतस्तेन रावणेन बलीयसा। संस्कृतश्चापि रामेण जगाम गतिमुत्तमाम्॥
en: Thus slain by the powerful Rāvana, the vulture, having had his funereal obsequies performed by Rama. (himself), has attained excellent state.

sa: अभिवादयमानं त्वामङ्गदं त्वं यथा पुरा॥ दीर्घायुर्भव पुत्रेति किमर्थं नाभिभाषसे।
en: (Thereupon Tāră said)—Saying 'Do you live long' why did you not welcome Angada, to-day as before, who has bowed to you?

sa: स्वयमातिथ्यमादिश्य सर्वमस्य सुसत्कृतम्। सौमित्रिं च महाभागं सीतां च समसान्त्वयत्॥
en: And having personally given Rāma respectful reception and entertainment, the ascetic regarded the exalted Lakşmaņa and Sītā with a gracious eye.

sa: ततस्तं घटमादाय पूर्णं परमवारिणा। आश्रमं तमहं प्राप्य यथाख्यातपथं गतः॥
en: Then taking up the pitcher filled with excellent water, I went by the way mentioned and (at last) reached the asylum.

sa: नीलोत्पलदलश्यामाः श्यामीकृत्वा दिशो दश। विमदा इव मातङ्गा शान्तवेगाः पयोधराः॥
en: Having made the ten quarters dark blue, the clouds, resembling blue lotuses, have become calm, like to elephants without temporal juice.

sa: ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानं गतेऽर्धदिवसे तदा। जाह्नवीं सरितां श्रेष्ठां ददृशुर्मुनिसेविताम्॥
en: Having proceeded far, when the day had been half spent, they beheld that foremost of streams, the Jahnavi, worshipped by ascetics.

sa: अभिवाद्य च वैदेही तापसी तां दमान्विताम्। बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा हृष्टा पर्यपृच्छदनामयम्॥
en: Having paid homage to that ascetic with her senses subdued, Vaidehi glad at heart, with joined hands, enquired after her welfare.

sa: अथ मध्यमकक्ष्यायां समागच्छत् सुहृज्जनैः। स सर्वानर्थिनो दृष्ट्वा समेत्य प्रतिनन्द्य च ॥ ततः पावकसंकाशमारुरोह रथोत्तमम्। वैयाघ्रं पुरुषव्याघ्रो राजितं राजनन्दनः॥
en: And met all his friends assembled at the middle apartment. Then that great son of the king, casting a glance upon them all who were present there to see him and pleasing them with sweet words ascended, like to the thousand-eyed Indra.

sa: रोषवेगप्रकुपितः श्रुत्वा चाभरणस्वनम्। चकार जायास्वनं वीरो दिशः शब्देन पूरयन्॥
en: And highly enraged at the sound of the ornaments, the hero filled all the quarters with the twang of his bow.

sa: तद् रामविशिखैश्छिन्नं शूलं तस्यापतद् भुवि। पपाताशनिना छिन्नं मेरोरिव शिलातलम्॥
en: And the dart severed by the shafts of Rāma, fell to the earth, as falls a crag severed by the thunderbolt.

sa: भरद्वाजस्ततः शिष्यो विनीतः श्रुतवान् गुरोः। कलशं पूर्णमादाय पृष्ठतोऽनुजगाम ह॥
en: His disciple also, accomplished in learning, and of meek demeanour, followed Vālmīki, carrying on his back a pitcher filled with water.

sa: स धनुर्धन्विनां श्रेष्ठः संगृह्य परमाहवे। मुमोच परमेष्वासः षट् शरानभिलक्षितान्॥
en: Thereupon that foremost of bowmen, and wielder of a mighty bow, taking six shafts, let them go, after aiming at them.

sa: स राजा पुत्रमायान्तं दृष्ट्वा चारात् कृताञ्जलिम्। उत्पपातासनात् तूर्णमार्तः स्त्रीजनसंवृतः॥
en: The king seeing his son drawing nigh with joined hands, nastily rose up from his seat in company with his wives.

sa: इति सा लक्ष्मणेनोक्ता कराला निर्णतोदरी। मन्यते तद्वचः सत्यं परिहासाविचक्षणा॥
en: Thus accosted by Lakşmaņa, that hideous one having a lean abdomen being incapable of understanding jest, took his words as true.
